Through the beach you can reach Parrot rock. It is a small island separated from the main land and you can have a mesmerizing 360° view of the sea when you climb up. You can swim in the Mirissa Main beach as well as the best place I found is the small beach situated on the right side of the Parrot rock. there the water is shallow for a long distance. But when you go further there will be rocks under water and you have to be careful of it. Waves are not very tide. Can enjoy a good evening swim there. Children also can enjoy a good swim there. There are some local restaurants by the beach. We did not go there so not sure about the food & beverages they have and the prices. The beach will be lightly crowded in the evening. But the best time to visit also is the evening, around 3-4. After a 1-2hr bath we went to have a hot tea and to eat something. We found this small place called "Spice Rotti shop" by the main road. It is on google map. the food was amazing and prices also very affordable. They have a variety of sri lankan foods and in there we met some foreign travellers also. They customize your food up to your taste. If you are around Mirissa prefer to try this place. Don't choose the rainy season to visit Mirissa, as the waves will be rough. Mirissa beach is a Must visit if you are a beach lover.

title: Miles of crashing waves
text: Beautiful clean beaches, with miles of golden sands. Mirissa was not as crowded,noisy or garish as we had anticipated. Lots of food & drink places directly on the beach. Prices are reasonable and the “happy hour” stretches from 1-11pm in some places. Several shops in the back streets and food generally cheaper there. Lovely rock to climb for lovely views

title: Very clean, lots of space, lots of food
text: I really loved Mirissa beach. Nice white sand, beautiful clear water and lots of options for places to eat and drink. The seafood is fresh and the restaurants are open from breakfast until after dark. A great spot, I didn't see any rubbish anywhere.

title: If you’re not a surfer, avoid this place
text: I am a good swimmer, I usually love the beach, but I could not enjoy Mirissa Beach. I would usually swim for 3 hours when I go to a beach. But here I stayed less than an hour. My fiancÃ©e can’t swim very well, so she stayed out of the water. The waves are unpredictable and can be very high and rough. I got tossed around like a child by a couple and even got slammed onto the sand by one and my shoulder is still sore days later. My biggest warning is not about the waves/surf though... after my short time swimming and even going back out to the open water to rub/brush off excess sand from myself, I found that sand had gotten everywhere and it was quite difficult to remove. I took 3 showers that night and still had sand all over. When I woke up the next morning, there was sand all over my bedsheets and pillow. After my 4th shower since my swim, I finally managed to rid myself of the feeling, but I don’t like the feeling of having sand everywhere. For surfers, you will love the beach, for non surfers (especially those who can’t swim strongly), I would recommend going elsewhere.

title: One of the best
text: The only place i would come back in Sri Lanka ! I loved Mirissa the most. A lot of beach bars, clean sand, international tourists. You can easily rent surfing boards, paddle boards and so on. This place is really prepared for foreign guests

title: Lots of people
text: Lots of people there. Plus many restaurants and small cafes. There are 2 volleyball fields to play. Waves make it fun for surfing

title: worth a visit
text: big bay with good beach big crashing waves coming in rock to climb on at one end gives a good view nice places to eat

title: Nice beach but very Western
text: The beach is nice, with clear water, but the problem are business that are located around it. They are very western-like targeting western customer so there is not much of local Sri Lankan spirit that one can feel while enjoying sun there.

title: Gorgeous beach
text: Mirissa beach is one of the best we've seen in Sri Lanka. It was not too crowded and it looked pretty nice. The ocean water was swimmable in January.

title: Wide, sandy beach with waves
text: The waves were quite big in the main part of the beach and I’m more of a calm water gal. Beautiful stretch of beach with clean, clear water and golden sand. Lots of moderate and budget hotels and restaurants along the beachfront.

title: Amazing Beach ??
text: Clean and clear water. Beautiful place to just relax and enjoy the water. Many diving center's around incase you plan to take a scuba diving trip.

title: Snorkling with turtles near Mirissa
text: We're in Mirissa for the final week of our trip and I've been stressing for ages about finding turtles and what beach you can see them near here. Google searches suggested we needed to go near Galle to see them, which was disappointing. But then we were recommended by our villa's manager to check out Polhena beach. We did a little research. Its 6 or 7 min tuk tuk ride towards Matara. We hired Nirosh as our guide after reading some good reviews. It was phenomenal!! Within 10 min we were hanging with turtles. The bay is shallow because of the coral and the waves are far calmer than Mirissa. Nirosh is absolutely sound guy and made the whole thing seem so easy. If you're in the area, its a definite must! You can find him at the Polhena Bay Resort or call him on 077 5481252. Peter

title: Get better with time
text: After coming from the east coast where we were the only people on the beach it was a bit of a shock arriving here. It is busy but no where near as busy as European beach resort. The sea and beach is fantastic and there is room to find a quiet spot. Great bus connects to Galle

title: Too much people
text: Beach it clean and beautiful, but too many people. For us it looks like Mallorca. Nothing more to say.

title: Mirissa beach
text: Very nice beach with a lit of restaurants! The beach is very clean with a lit of activities to do...

title: Worth a visit
text: Clean beach with soft white sand. Large enough to accommodate the crowds. Plenty of options to dine on the beach with the waves lapping away at your feet.

title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
text: Great Holiday Beach nice clean water with a decent wave for body surfing, can be a bit of a powerful shore dump so a bit of caution is recommended. Plenty of lunch options after a swim as well with a few cleansing ales. ??

title: Must visit, serene
text: Must visit, serene beach... go for lovely beach side experience. Have time to explore around the area..

title: Great beach for swim and relax
text: Lovely fine sand and clear warm water secure its place as probably the finest on the traveller trail around SL. Easy to hire surf or body boards we spent most of our time at the Bay Moon which we felt was the nicer side of the beach.

title: Very dangerous waves
text: I broke my neck and nearly died when a wave crashed me in to the sea floor. Lots of people in the sea and the waves didn’t appear very dangerous. Another guy broke his shoulder. Do not swim here unless the waves are very small.

title: Lovely Beach
text: We stayed here for three nights, and we truly enjoyed the soothing vibe and being able to walk along the beach to spend a dinner and some beers. We are welcomed with small waves and decided to go for a surf. Next day morning we went for whale watching & it was a very good experience.

title: Beautiful beach, but strong waves
text: Absolutely beautiful beach, but you need to be careful. Quite dangerous waves. I, perhaps through not being careful enough entering the water got caught by a wave, thrown over and smashed my head on the sea bed. Was pretty nasty, and could easily have been even worse than the bumps, bruises and cuts I ended up with. It is absolutely spectacular, and I don't suggest missing it, just be careful. Particularly with kids. If it can throw a grown man around like a rag doll, then you can work out the rest... This notwithstanding, hundreds of people were swimming and surfing, so it's obviously possible to do with care.

title: Fantastic beach
text: Lovely beach and this was in the off season, so imagine what it’s like in full swing!! The beach is very clean and we had some gorgeous views

title: Beautiful beach!
text: We’re staying in Mirissa for 3 nights and this beach is beautiful, it’s the first time we’ve been able to swim in the sea since we’ve been in Sri Lanka. It’s low season so not all of the restaurants and bars along the beach are open but it’s worth a visit for some serious relaxation and a happy hour or two at one of the beach bars never harms anyone!

title: Wavy but enjoyable
text: We liked the time we spent in Mirissa Beach. It is wavy and has a lot of currents but it’s kept clean by the bars on the sand and it’s calm and enjoyable.

title: Off season opinion only
text: Lovely beach to walk along, BUT if you are travelling the East coast and making your way South take your time! The beaches are hardly swim-able here. This we knew but couldn’t get any updates on the current situation, so here it is for others like us. Rough waters!

title: Amazing beach and sand
text: Mirissa is an amazing beach.I love sooo much. Can't wait for next time .amazing sunset. Good to relax and chill. Will be soon

title: beach from the postcard
text: Very nice beach, clean, some waves. Many cosy bars and restaurants. sand is white and soft, there are some trees to hide.

title: Beautiful clean beach with number of restaurants along the shore to relax and grab food and a drink...
text: I stayed in Mirissa for a couple of days and I visited the mirissa beach almost everyday on my trip. It is a very beautiful beach with a curved coastline/shore. I was there in the month of may, near to off season and there were high tides. Still people were taking a swim along the coast and enjoying the tides. I loved the view and had a great time relaxing in the beach as i stayed near to the beachside. Anyone visiting mirissa must visit this beach. During the evening the restaurants have beautiful arrangements with candles along the shore to give it a beautiful ambience. I completely fell in love with this place.

title: paradise
text: Mirissa is paradise....we loved it because it is a stunning and clean beach and was filled with families. Coconut tree fringed beach, clear clean waters, surfing on both ends, body boarding in middle, snorkelling & coral on one side, good for kids.

title: Heaven on earth!
text: Very very special place! Probably the best beach in Sri Lanka. Great to surf and watch turtles, whales, dolphins, funny crabs. The waves are huge and it’s amazing to dive and swim in that sea. The food at the bars is also very good with many vegan options! People there are also very nice and kind ??

title: Beautiful one day perfect the next
text: Had a great time staying at Marissa we stayed across the main road at the southern end of the beach at The Spice Garden and walked the beach each day before breakfast then came back to swim in the beautiful warm water. We hired snorkels mask and flippers from Sandru up near the Sea Star hotel and swam gently with Turtles amazing experience and worth doing. Sandru is most accommodating and trust worthy he even took one family out while I minded the gear.

title: Beautiful
text: A really beautiful beach.We made the mistake of not spending the night in minissa and made a day trip from Colombo. I would seriously advise to spend a night here .It's worth it. The whale watching is great too.

title: Lovely beach
text: This was the high point of our travel and we wished we had spent more time here. The water was warm and blue. We saw baby turtles being released into the ocean. Sat by one of the beachside restaurants with drinks and snacks. A beautiful evening!

title: nice sunset
text: Famous for its beaches known by many as the "Golden Mile" of beaches, Mount Lavinia has been a hot spot for tourism and laid back nightlife. Many beach restaurants scattered on the beach serving continental menus, eastern and local cuisine, fresh seafood beverages and liquor adds color to the area. The golden mile is undoubtedly is the best beach stretch closest to Colombo and attracts the locals in numbers during the evenings.

title: The Hotel With A Large Private Beach
text: After a sumptuous lunch, we visited Mount Lavinia's private beach. Despite the hot sun and humidity, my daughter-in-law and 8-year-old granddaughter happily walked a couple of hundred yards in the sand to feel the waters of the Indian Ocean. We all loved the experience of visiting this iconic heritage hotel.

title: Sunset is amazing!
text: Great way to escape the chaos of Colombo for sunset - truly breathtaking views. Watch the locals and their kids cooling off in the water after work before grabbing some dinner and a cocktail at one of the local restaurants.

title: Friends
text: We were on a cruise and spent a day in Sri Lanka. Our wonderful driver drive us to this beach bar. We were hoping for curry but it didn’t happen. However we had a very reasonable fish and chips meal looking out onto a beautiful beach.

title: Old world charm and service
text: Old world colonial building that was the Governors mansion turned into a superb hotel, food is absolutely outstanding so is the service, private beach, they look after you very well, relaxing and really good security, they get to know you. I have been back many times. outside the private beach not so nice, where the public can go in Mount Lavinia they ruin it, Sri Lankan's in general are a dirty bunch You really do not need much more, not quite as luxurious as some of the other hotels, but certainly good vale for money

title: A good beach to relax & enjoy the vast Indian Ocean!
text: It's a nice beach and quite long too. There are few restaurants and cafe all across Mt. Lavinia area. The beach is relatively clean. I couldn't find any water sports activity there. Good place to relax and spend 2-3 hours. Would recommend to visit in evening so that the sun becomes bearable plus can witness the sunset across the vast ocean. Families with young kids should carry some water and light snacks. I could not spot any restrooms in the vicinity.

title: So dirty
text: I was recommended the beach so much that when I went finally I was disappointed by the amount of trash floating around. Unless you go to MT Lavinia hotel beach which is beautifully clean then I would not recommend stunning around otherwise. There are plenty of other more beautiful beaches around than this one.

title: Dirty and full of trash
text: beach is quiet dirty and no one to clean it up, local people camping along the beach and throw their trash into the ocean. there are a few beach cafe privately owned and are collecting fees to use their umbrella and chair with life guard. lots of people hassle tourist to buy coconut (not ready to drink where its too young and have a sour taste) and other stuff. *Colombo people need to clean up this beach

title: nice, but be careful
text: beautiful beach but watch out for the current; better go to the other side of Mt Lavinia hotel - amazing there!

title: Excellent
text: Special Thanks for Vishan fo showing me the hotel. Must stay place. Fabulous beach and excellent property. Thank you Vishan for taking care so much.

title: OVERNIGHT STAY
text: Traditional Hotel Originally the English Governor's abode. New & old wing ! Outside but near enough to busy COLOMBO. NICE POOL & BEACH. Excellent breakfast buffet & terrace. VERY GOOD FOOD. RECOMMENDED!

title: Good beach, excellent hotel
text: Good beach to hang out when you are staying in the Mount Lavina hotel. Not too crowded and you can spend a quite time. The beach has got a few restaurants & shacks when good food can be found.

title: excellent clean beach
text: we spent time in colombo and even though the beach runs along the length of colombo ,this is one of the best beaches for visitors to colombo. we went on a boat ride and hopped on a small island full of oysters. The scrawny man who was strong pulled us on to the island as there was no natural place to have a foot hold with oysters being smashed by others. The man served the oysters with lime and pepper or on its own on plates after we landed back on the beach. Regret going close to dusk as in Sri Lanka darkness falls within minutes and we could not see turtles

title: Excellent!
text: My family and I have travelled to many different countries and stayed at hotels varying from 3 star to 5 star but Mountlavinia hotel was like no other! We booked 2 interconnecting, oceanview rooms (346 and 347) and spent 12 glorious days at this beautiful, historic hotel. The service from doorman to cleaner was exceptional. Staff went above and beyond to make sure our stay was pleasant and enjoyable. The breakfast buffet was a feast and the staff was amazing! We didn't have the dinner buffet during our stay but enjoyed the lunch buffet on 1 day. Great spread! The view from our rooms was to die for! Morning coffee on the balcony, watching the waves roll below you was the highlight of my stay. Our 2 young daughters loved the pool and the 'free historic tour' offered by the hotel. I would gladly recommend this hotel to anyone. The staff were friendly, hard working and very efficient. Shout out to Mendis(doorman), Tiddy, Ranjith, Kumari, Priyanthi(restaurant) and Saman(roomboy)

title: Mount Lavinia by Dr.Saleh Bakar
text: Beautiful place a bit far from the centre but worth watching. you can take bus no 136 from City and in 20RS can reach there. Tuk Tuk takes 600RS but if you use UBER TUK TUK that will take 400max

title: One of Sri Lanka’s best beaches.
text: Take the time to eat a buffet lunch and purchase a swim at the Mount Lavinia hotel. A beautiful colonial hotel that is charming and attractive. After take a lovely walk and sway in the hammocks of mount Lavinia beach. Attendants will assist you with drinks and snacks.

title: Littered with trash
text: This beach is littered with trash from the ocean. If you stay along the 200 meters near to the Mr Lavinia hotel it is nice as they keep it clean...after that it is disgusting.

title: Very nice
text: I spend three nights in bentota. Then i went to visit Mount lavinia beach in Colombo some hours only . Mount lavinia beach is a very nice place . If want to stay in colombo The best place is to be close to this beach

title: Great relaxing beach ??
text: Wonderful relaxing beach ?? with good facilities, part of the hotel but visitors allowed with small fee which includes lunch & a drink. Not far from Colombo city centre & nice atmosphere

title: Beautiful beach particularly as it is so close to the city
text: I was really amazed by Mount Lavinia Beach. I didn't expect it to be as attractive or as swimmable and I was surprised at how few people were on the beach when we were there. We loved watching the fishermen pulling in their enormous nets (such a huge amount of effort for such a small catch) On the whole for a city beach it was pretty clean, there are plenty of little bars and restaurants and the sunset views are really lovely. I think staying in this much quieter area with access to the beach and good public transport in to Colombo is a winner and Inwill definitely visit again

title: Busy but enjoyable beach!
text: We were here on an early Saturday morning. It was quite busy but in a good way. People were walking, exercising and sunbathing as well. Our hotel, Berjaya was right beside the beach and we had an over-bridge to reach the beach from our hotel (there was a train track under the bridge). There were a few restaurants that were literally on the beach itself. It's a fairly long beach. There were some watersports activities happening. I remember jet skiing. Although, we didn't do any.

title: Nothing special
text: the beach is beautiful and has some unexploited potential. I found it ok but couldn't swim as the season for swimming was off and stream was strong and dangerous. Bars and restaurants do not offer anything special and look like expensive to me. You get annoyed by some beach boys; drug addicts look for clients and sell coconut and may keep your change. Beware, be straightforward and firm about what you want and don't want. Women, beware as well. Lots of people on weekends and holydays. I stayed two months in the area and found it rather sad and boring. I am not sure if people were friendly or hypocrit

title: Place with decent beach and shopping options
text: Visited on 22nd February 2020 This place is about 8 kms from central Colombo and provides good sea beach hotels within budget. The place is also dotted with shopping stores and restaurants for getting the local taste and affordable shopping. Spices and tea could be bought from this place at very competitive prices. Visit the beach and enjoy a drink in the shacks Check out this place.

title: Beautiful beach
text: The beach is really beautiful and wonderful for a morning walk and to chill out amazing sea and nature place

title: Lovely beach to enjoy a swim
text: Enjoyed the morning at the beach. Hired chairs and towels for 250 rupees. Very pleasant surroundings. Enjoyed milkshakes. Nice place to chill out and relax

title: Wonderful beaches.
text: Right on our door step. Beaches run for miles. Clean and beautiful sand. People pulling in nets, fishing boats pulled up on shore, restaurants every now and then.

title: Seafood heaven
text: We went here one evening last week and had a fabulous meal. It's so much better to be able to see and select you're own seafood. We will definitely be back

title: Lovely Beach w/Plenty Of Bars & Restaurants
text: We stayed a stone throw away from Mount Lavinia Beach, so we could maximise the beach time we had. We were not disappointed and enjoyed long walks on the beach, with plenty of bars & restaurants scattered along the shoreline. You can hire sun loungers from as little as 250 LKR or 500 LKR at the fancier places. You will find the odd person patrolling the beach selling fruit, souvenirs, tours and even narcotics (if that's your thing). Overall, it's a nice beach close to the train tracks (which can be noisy) and a little busier than I would like but well worth a visit away from the hustle and bustle of Colombo.

title: Great Place
text: I was only there for one day but was that spectacular... clean beach close to all the amenities you could desire.

title: Short night visit
text: A colleague who lived near by took me to this beach after the sunset. Even in the night ot looked nice with a lot of open restaurants and guests enjoying sea breeze.

title: great private beach
text: This is the best part of a very good hotel,the restaurant is first class if you are a fish fan. the beach is well run with staff to ensure you are comfortable.

title: LOVE THE BEACHES ??
text: Mount Beach has always been a great getaway with or without kids .. with the right balance of romance in the evenings to the sounds of the waves and the city lights to the sunsets with kids running along the beach while we chill out ..

title: Beautiful setting for dinner!
text: What a beautiful place to sit and eat dinner. We arrived before dark and watched the sun go down with cocktail in hand, what a treat! We then went and chose our fish, how we would like it cooked and what we would like to go with it. The waiter was very busy trying to up sell all the time but we quickly realised and asked to reduce the amount of prawns and squid by half and we still had more than plenty! The food was delicious, the setting lovely and the staff ok, the only place we visited in the whole of our Sri Lankan trip where they really did not care, though it did not deter from a very pleasant evening.

title: Holiday
text: A quiet beach superb for the early swim.Weekends a little busy but still good.Very enjoyable and many things happening to keep you entertained.

title: Fabulous stretch of golden yellow sand
text: Beautiful beach along which to walk through the waves as they crash into shore. A couple of beach side cafes restaurants offered a good selection of food & drink all day and a seafood market cooked to order in the eve.

title: Nice beach and accessible from central Colombo
text: This is the nearest beach of colombo city after Gall face and more clean , food options available. We enjoyed a lot.

title: You might see a Turtle if you're lucky.
text: A selection of good bars to be enjoyed as you stroll along the beach, and if you're there at the right time of year you may be fortunate enough, "as we were", to see a turtle come ashore to lay its eggs.

title: Great Beach
text: Lovely beach and very good FRESH fish at the `Mount Lavinia Hotel'. Four of us had three meals there and not disappointed by a single dish. Fireworks on the beach on one evening was a magical experience.

title: Excellent place
text: The beach was located in mount lavania it's a very nice beach n clean beach .And they is a lot of restaurant near buy

title: Beautiful clean Sandy Beach
text: The beach was absolutely amazing, so clean and well kept with plenty of beds to relax and take in the views. There are places to eat and drink as well as just chill in the beautiful warm sunshine

title: Lovely hotel and restaurant
text: Former governor's residence from 1812 extended and converted into a top class hotel virtually on the beach. Very comfortable and spacious with very helpful and friendly staff. Amazing breakfast buffet, second to none. Great fresh fish restaurant on the beach - select your fish, choose your sauce and there it is and right on the sandy shore. Room large and stylish with an excellent bathroom. Bet a bit hard for me and no topper was forthcoming - my only complaint. Would have liked to stay longer than 5 days

title: Public beach dirty and rubbish strewn. No where to eat very disappointing
text: We visited the public beach from mount Lavinia hotel. The hotel stretch is clean the public beach covered in rubbish. Nothing to recommend visiting it.

title: Beach Boys and Girls Welcome
text: Mount Lavinia Beach is not one of Sri Lanka’s great seaside venues, but if you want to take a stroll along the ocean in the city, do get down to Mount Lavinia!

title: Golden...
text: This beach is located a bit outside colombo but worth visiting. A clean golden sand beach with blue water and cool breeze.

title: Babu Restaurant on the beach
text: Really lovely beach, would definitely go back. We settled for sitting outside Babu Restaurant. Nice seats and we didn’t get hassled by anyone.

title: Love this hotel
text: This Old Colonial hotel is one of my faves! Love their high tea! You fee like you are entering the Old and exotic Sri Lanka that used to be.. the doormen are dressed in clothing from the past and we love it. The food is great and this place has a buffet that’s served in clay pots. Great ambiance and the seating area is aim clear view of the beach which you can walk to, easily. A must visit!

title: Beautiful!
text: We took the train from Colombo which was a bit hectic but worth the trip. It’s a beautiful beach and despite the monsoon season and the sea being a bit rough, it was still beautiful and one can only imagine how appealing it would be in peak season. The town itself has a few tourist shops which appear ok. Mount Lavinia has an interesting history to its name which is romantic. Worth a visit

title: The beach is just about ok. You can't swim or get in the water
text: The closest beach from the city. The sea was rough. You can't get in the water. Also mostly local crowd and less tourists. Would not recommend to a tourists..I am sure there are better beaches here.

title: Party on Beach
text: I can say that this is a hot spot for tourism and nightlife. There are a lot of restaurants in beach side and some have good music system. I think evening time is the best time to visit there. Finally if ever been to Colombo never miss this place to visit.

title: Amazing selection of food and service
text: Great food and top notch service with incredible beaches!! It was amazing two weeks of experience in Sri Lanka. Need lest to say I had a privilege to dine Vegan buffet in Mount Lavinia Hotel . I am excited to say that fascinating selection of food to indulge you. Also, implacable service which is top notch, food verities far better than what I have seen quite some time. It is fabulous to see that MLH continue to do better when it’s come to food and service. Keep it up!

title: Wow
text: This beach was really fantastic it its own way and we had a spicy sea food near that in a beach restaurant and was very delicious i dont have any mind to get out of the beach because of its calmness

title: Lovely sunset
text: Took a Tuk tuk north to Mount Lavinia- The sunset did not disappoint. Afterwards we found a local hotel for a simple meal and headed back into Colombo by tuk tuk

title: Went their for a dinner
text: A British Time hotel which also famous for their beach restaurant and has good view to the sea but the quality of food was not up to mark when I was there don’t know why !!!! But as whole seemed great to me

title: nice beach
text: The ocean was too rough to swim in at the time we traveled but the atmosphere and cleanliness of the beach was excellent.

title: A favourite spot for people of all ages to hangout
text: The beach at Mount Lavinia is one of the most popular spots in Colombo, whether it’s for taking a cool dip in the bright blue ocean, or just to soak up some sun. The beautiful stretch of fine sandy shore paired with foaming waves at Mount Lavinia attracts families and young cliques alike. You will find on the beach, children running around, chasing each other and playing with the sand while their parents stand close by with watchful eyes and take in the sea breeze and picturesque scenery. Some are seen taking their canine friends out for a walk, and couples can be spied taking a stroll, hand in hand along the sea’s edge. The beach is also a favourite choice for school field trips, picnics and photo shoots.

title: Beautiful beach
text: We accessed this beach through the hotel. For 1,000LKR you can access the hotels beach and pool ( pool closes at 8). Gives you access to the showers and beds on the beach. There is also a life guard and marked areas to swim ( or not ) You can walk further down the beach and stay for free! We visited off season and the place was empty! Easy to get a Tuk Tuk from the hotels entrance home.

title: ?? nice spot, close to the city ??
text: As far as beaches go, Colombo is a challenge. Their railway line runs between the high tide mark & the road, cutting off this most interesting of features ~ the seashore. From Mount Lavinia Hotel you can access a brilliant piece of this coast | beach. Beach huts with food, drinks + massages available. Unfortunately as soon as you get passed the Hotel managed portion of the ?? ~ plastic, glass + rubbish take over.

title: Shafraz mohamed
text: Great Sri Lanka restaurant with great service and the most romantic view in the city during night time

title: Beautiful
text: This is lovely beach strip located outside Colombo. Many tourist visit this place to relax and enjoy. It's clean and relaxing

title: Charming hotel
text: Enchanting and historical hotel with all the best services. On a beautiful beach, it seems to be in the last century. For me it is also very important, because during this holiday, my beloved father was with me. ?? RIP DAD ??

title: Nice Place
text: It was an unforgettable two weeks of experience in Sri Lanka. Very nice and clean beach. So many good hotels.Need in the case to tell that I had a privilege to eat Vegan buffet in one hotel there. I am thrilled to say that there’s an amazing selection of food to enjoy.

title: Excellent
text: Clean and tidy. Peaceful beach. Look out for lifesaving warning signs. There are rocky areas on one side. Beautiful beach

title: Mount Lavinia
text: Had a great time at Mount Lavinia hotel. The beach area is good but you have to be very careful if you venture into the sea, the morning time is best as the currents are not too strong but in the afternoon, even as a strong swimmer, I struggled to cope with them and I would recommend that you do not go in too far as it can be very dangerous. There are a few eating places on the beach, good food and great value, in fact it is very difficult to spend money in Sri Lanka unless you decide to go on day trips to see Elephant, Leopard etc.

title: Beautiful Sunsets Here.
text: The beach in front of the hotel is quite nice and clean although not huge. Good for a dip if you don't want to use the hotel pool. Walk around the point and you'll be disappointed and saddened by the mounds of plastic waste and rubbish the locals just pile up.

title: Lovely
text: A lovely beach with a collection of lovely restaurants with varying prices and menus. Just a shame that there seems to be lots of litter left around. A must see if you come to Mount Lavinia

title: Beautiful!
text: We happened to go to this beach at night and fell for it instantly! It was Christmas time and everyone was in the festive mood. You can find some cool parties happening this side. The restaurants, beach snacks are awesome and the beach is quite wide. Had an amazing time!

title: Oh loved it!!!
text: This beach was just in front of our hotel and we loved it. Its a regular beach with some cafes’ n stall to eat..the good thing is its not very crowded(or was not when we went).. N nice waves too

title: Stunning location but awful staff in resaurant.
text: Stayed here for the last night of a Mercury Tour of Sri Lanka. The hotel is in a stunning location with amazing views over the beach. The hotel is obviously very old but has been modernised to a decent standard. The food was absolutely stunning with an amazing choice, spread over two rooms, best we encountered on our stay in the country. However the service in the restaurant was really poor. It was difficult to order a drink at the table and very slow to arrive once ordered. Used plates were not cleared and were allowed to pile up on the table. Such a shame as the food was so good. Finally as it was the last night of our tour and we were all going our seperate ways the following day we decided to go for a few drinks outside around the pool. Could not get anyone to take the drinks order until we went and found a reluctant waiter who took one look at the size of the goup, took the the first couple of orders and just left us sitting there whilst he went and started clearing plates from other tables which was quite ironic following our experiences in the restaurant. Eventually someone went and got a manager who did take the order but the drinks were very slow to arrive. In some cases well over 30 minutes. Such a shame that this level of service lets down the hotel, and spoilt what should have been a pleasant evening at the end of our tour.

title: Good place to visit
text: Our trip of beach was full of fun and enjoyment but we observed that no much activities are being taken place on beach side

title: A lovely beach edging the capital city
text: Mount Lavania, is a wonderful beach right next to the city. It is not a scenic beach like other Sri Lankan beaches, but it is still very beautiful. I love to watch the sunset here, or sit close to beach and have a cup of tea in one of the local hotels. If you don't have the time to go out of Colombo, this is the best beach to visit.

title: Not the Mount Lavinia I remember
text: I was a little shocked at how downtrodden this beach was. When I was a child, this beach seemed a lot more attractive. It was pretty deserted when I was there, and the sea seemed too rough & unclean to swim safely. There were also quite a few men roaming around trying to sell their art or services, be warned. They will go away if you ask, but you will have to be firm! Go visit Mount Lavinia Hotel for a swim and watch the sunset, it is the best part of this area....

title: Great for beach picknicking
text: We went on a Saturday AND Sunday morning - it's a 30 minutes to 45 minute drive from Colombo on a weekend morning. The sea was too rough for proper swimming but perfect for paddling (we had a 5 year old with us) and shell collecting. The beach was cleaner on Saturday morning than it was on Sunday morning (debris from the Saturday night crowds?). We took a picnic mat and food and was quite undisturbed by beggars or beach urchins which was a relief - there were mainly families with kids having fun. There was lots of sandcastle building going on and burying family members in sand! We had taken our bucket and spades along, so we joined in the fun. Perfect family morning picnic by he sea.

title: a serene quiet beautiful beach
text: well maintained and tucked away in the mesmerizing Mount Lavinia location....everytime one visits it, the trip enhances its attraction for returning....lovely

title: Rough and Ready
text: The sea was quite rough. Bit unsafe but brilliant place to walk and play games with friends. Rather crowded on weekends and holidays.

title: Long Sandy Beach
text: The Beach is fantastic for relaxing and walking in the waves. The sea is very rough - as I was there in May it was not possible to swim. Fortunately, there is a Mount Lavinia Hotel nearby where you can swim in the outside pool with large terrace and beautiful sea view.

title: Comparative Calm Beach
text: The ocean here is quite rough but no crowds and hence a great place to visit. You shall find few newly to be married couples getting photographed here. Must visit.

title: Getting There is Half the Fun
text: From my hotel in Colombo, I made the short ten rupees trip to Mount Lavinia. My hotel was a short walk from the Kollupitiya Railway Station and so only four stops to Mount Lavinia. I was offered a seat by a family, on the train, but opted to stand at the opened door and take photos. Once there, I walked the short distance to the Mount Lavinia hotel, had a Coke, then made my way to the beach. It was a red flag day, but beautiful. In better weather conditions, I would have spend much more time there.

title: Super Beach!
text: This is one of the best beaches in the world. Very clean and nice beach with lots of small hotels to grab a beer, and a snack. We enjoy the Mount Lavinia Hotel which was on the beach and the restaurant with one of the famous chefs. Very good food and excellent service.

title: Nice Evening
text: Nice sandy beach for relax in evening after arriving to Sri lanka in long fly journey. Enjoyed well the evening.

title: Nice sandy beach in the area with lot of sea food restrants
text: Mount Lavinia beach is the best beach within the Colombo area , white sandy beach ideal for swimming , walking , or an evening family out , along the beach there plenty of restaurants most of them are specialise in sea foods , a good place to have a romantic dinner.

title: Gorgeous beach!!
text: I adore this beach!! The golden sand goes on forever, the sea is very rough so I don’t recommend you swim in the sea. The views of mount Lavinia hotel are beautiful and very picturesque. If your ever in mount Lavinia, visiting this beach is a must.

title: Beautiful Beach
text: Spending time on the Mt Lavinia beach is a must for those visiting Colombo. Plenty of cafes right along the beach which will cater for your every need. Friday & Saturday nights offer good music for those who like to party.

title: Too Doorman Ranjith
text: Great hospitality from the door man Ranjith polite and attentive. The beach is great and they filmed the Bridge over the River Kwai here a great setting for a family hiliday with a fantastic private beach.

title: Okay beach
text: Quiet beach close to town. Pretty clean beach but some suspect material in the water on the day we were there. But overall ok.

title: Beach for Convenience
text: This beach is located close to Colombo. It’s very active and not super peaceful. The tides are also really strong. A man was retrieved from the water with few people in his family noticing his absent. I didn’t stick around to see if they were able to resuscitate him. I’d be weary about having the elderly children, or anyone for that matter playing in these waters. I visited this beach after spending time in Hikkaduwa, Mirissa and Hiriketiya. The pollution, caused by the crowds really takes away from the beach. In retrospect, I should have spent two hours to make it back to Hikkaduwa. Watch the sunset here and drink a beer.

title: quite and beautiful beach
text: beautiful landmark and horizontal view from beach and sea with mix yellow sand and tree .there are restaurants close to the beach with beds.

title: Beautiful sunset with puppy
text: Relaxing with beer & friends in Mt. Lavinia sunset beach. Nice view. You can enjoy everything here like local.

title: Little tired but good for a stop over
text: We stayed here for one night, breaking up our stay in Sri Lanka before taking a flight from Columbo to Male. Unfortunately when we arrived they had messed up our booking so thought we were due to stay the next evening. Once they had realised this was incorrect it was sorted pretty quickly and consequently I think we actually got a room upgrade, after all it was our honeymoon. The hotel has a nice pool which also has some amazing sea views. It has its own beach and a number of other facilities. I got the impression however, that despite the very impressive entrance and grand nature of the hotel it was quite tired and dated. If I’m honest it needs quite a significant amount of investment to bring it back to its former glory. The staff also failed to make the best impression - there seemed a lack of coordination and knowledge, for example when we received a call to say our driver had arrived we returned to reception only to find no one seemed to know who our driver was or had any recollection of the fact they’d called us. We ate in the seafood restaurant on the beach which was lovely and very good value for money. You weigh out your fish and it’s cooked to how you like it, id defiantly recommend this. Breakfast in the Grovenors restaurant was a bit of a shambles. Whilst the food was okay we were put out by the very poor service - we were not seated so tried to find our own seat to find all of them had reserved signs. When we had no option but to sit in one of these we were confronted with a very cross waiter who told us to move but could not suggest a seat. Not ideal! Overall for a quick pit stop in Columbo I would recommend this hotel, however not for more than a couple of nights.

title: Great escape from the city madness
text: Good, clean sandy beach about 3 km long in the southern reaches of Colombo. It’s accessible by train from Colombo Fort which is the best option. Also bus 101 from the Fort although the bus takes about an hour due to the traffic. Tuk-tuk would be a quicker option than the bus but much more expensive. The beach is really very pleasant and makes for a great escape from the chaos of Colombo. Waves were quite rough when we were there but it didn’t stop people swimming and made for good body boarding. There is a variety of bars and restaurants on the beach.

title: Great beach in Colombo city
text: The Beach is really nice for relaxing & unwinding right in Colombo. Clean beach & great view of Arabian sea is ideal for locals & tourists.

title: Average hotel, good for first night in Sri Lanka
text: The hotel is in a good location but the rooms and main lobby areas are tired, and the service very hit and miss. The buffet dinner and breakfast weren’t very good. Would only recommend for a first night after arriving.

title: Mrs
text: Excellent hotel with old colonial spirit. Felt so spoiled by the wonderful staff! The rooms are very comfortable, the view tremendously out over the ocean. New Year’s Eve was a super party. Loved the choice and taste of food!

title: A family day out
text: Good place to enjoy a relaxing day with the family, best times are around 8-11am and 3-6pm. The beach is fairly clean and not many touts about the place, probably because there are several restaurants on the beach and I don't think that they would tolerate the likes of them. It can get a bit crowded expecially during the holidays and weekends, but overall if you plan your outing it can be a good day out. (I'm not vouching for the weather gods). Have fun. Cheers

title: Evening walk
text: Nice to walk and many restaurant are there for snacks and tea and coffee ?? Cleanse was ok Nice view and very beautiful

title: Gorgeous venue
text: An historic building in s beautiful setting which provides a stunning location for any visit. Rooms and areas of relaxation are of s good standard and the restarants and beach snack locations are excellent. The sea is safe with a clean sandy beach. A worth while location to visit or stay at.

title: Better place to go
text: We were the closer friends yesterday went to the beach and enjoyed lot,,, chilling near the Restaurants,, Beach was quite and tranquil place in overall,,, Amazing night and awesome but not in a gooder way,, but in comparison other beaches superb but hv to come up more activities,, will recommend others as well,,,,

title: Beautiful and pleasant beach
text: Few minutes drive from Colombo, beach has too many s shacks to serve and party, good for all sorts of crowd.

title: Nice place to stroll
text: We took the train from Colombo Fort Station to Mt Lavinia. Visited the former Governor's Residence then walked north up the beach to the next railway station and took a train back into the city. We found good eateries and saw fishermen tending their boats, and lads playing cricket on the sand. Friendly place!

title: Lively and expansive
text: Mount Lavinia Beach is quite large so it doesn’t feel crowded. If staying in Colombo, it is a short train ride. There are numerous restaurants and bars along the beach. One can walk for quite a distance in this beach, which is fantastic and very relaxing. There are plenty of people, both local and visitors, so the atmosphere is very welcoming and relaxing. Colombo’s urban agglomeration can be seen in the far distance.

title: Nice place for a walk
text: It’s a quite place and nice walk in the night or u go for a stroll. And it’s safe as well there are some places to eat, if you want to try some seafood However the experience is nice being there and enjoying the sunset and the calm place not many hawkers to bother you.

title: Very Dirty Beach
text: Not very impressive I must say. Only thing working for it was that it is public beach around colombo. It was very dirty with plastic bottles and wrappers washed off the shore.

title: Excellent place to hang out and party at Night
text: As we we were on our Offsite of our company, we had our DJ Night party on the beach , let me tell you it has traditional Mount Lavina hotel on the beach and this beach is attached to the hotel. Perfect gateway with family and host of foods to enjoy.

title: Nice hotel
text: It was my third visit in this Hotel. This Time i had halfbord Service. Dinner it was fantastic, food very nice elaborated with Love. My Special thanks to Mr. Dimuthu He was very kind. Best regards from Swizerland R.O

title: Cool, breezy and clean beach
text: The place is very clean with lots of really night watery places. Safe and water is clear . Lots of activities done full day as well after sun set also. Lots of restaurants with full of sea food menus. Live performances. Full chill out location. Scenic view is awesome.

title: Good
text: Sea Cove, best fish. Beach wild. Staff not good. Near Colombo, very good to spend one Sunday afternoon.

title: Very clean beach
text: This place was very clean with lots of really night watery places. Aim to eat near the mount Lavinia hotel for some of the best! Take you’re rubbish with you and put it in the bin, keep it clean!

title: Beautiful beach
text: I spent a wonderful couple of days enjoying this beach during late October of 1980. The waters are calm and warm enough that you can float for a long time without getting the chills. There are warnings about riptides, though , if you venture out too far. ( the when drop down list only has 2018 in it, but the geological features are still relevant). this beach is lose to the hotel, as well as the train and is a nice afternoon's walk from the downtown/Fort area - about 2 1/2 hours.

title: stunning
text: A beautiful sandy stretch of beach on the Indian Ocean great for a long morning walk along the waters edge. Several beach side restaurants and bars .Great for dinner as well as a casual breakfast or Coffee to pass the time.

title: Take the train from Colombo
text: The train ride from Colombo to Mount Lavinia is about 15-20 minutes - what a fantastic experience. So glad we did this. It cost just pennies and runs right next to the coast. Beautiful scenery. Unlike Britain with its health and safety regulations, the doors don’t shut on this train - you just hang on and hang out! Amazing, and if you’re lucky a man will come along the train with fresh pineapples. When you come out of the station at mount Lavinia, turn left then left again and left again. You’ll cross the train track (just walk over it like the locals do) and be right on the beach with views back to Colombo. The Mount Lavinia hotel is worth a visit too

title: Average beach
text: Mount Lavinia Beach is a small patch of beach close to Colombo, just south of the city. It is an average beach as such because I found that the shacks didn't really maintain the acceptable level of hygiene and the beach was broadly speaking quite littered. Now I won't be the first one to say that it was filthy, but it is a bit over crowded and that is only adding to the problem. Mt Lavinia beach has great scope for becoming a welcome short drive from Colombo, but thanks to the increasing traffic and over crowding it is being slowly becoming like most of the beaches in the sub continent.

title: Good Beach
text: Nice beach with nice view one can watch nicely Sunset there and can enjoy beauty of nature just nearby one Railway line is there where train passes in regular intervals

title: Nice beach near Colombo!!
text: Nice beach near Colombo city. Has some good scenic views. The tides are good is a place to visit in Colombo city.

title: We use to enjoy our morning run on the beach What a shame that we cannot do it anymore!
text: Very sad to see this beautiful beach which was once a clean and a nice place to go for a morning run or a stroll, is now dirty. We saw plastic bags of curry, plastic bottles and garbage thrown on the beach. Why isn't anyone responsible to maintain the beach? This is the only beach in Colombo that people can enjoy. Why is keeping the beach clean such a hard thing to do? It is also very crowded in the evenings. The only time it's a bit quiet is in the afternoon. Good for a sea bath. But of course it's terribly hot. Nice restaurants close by.

title: True Sri Lankan experience
text: Want to experience Sri Lanka beaches like a local... head here. It’s great but not the white sands and sun lounges with shady palm trees! It’s the grungy Sri Lanka with locals playing soccer, warm beers served on plastic outdoor furniture and plenty of hawkers with dancing monkeys and cobra snakes ??

title: Best beach for relaxation
text: Lavinia beach best relaxation via Galle road in south part Colombo. where you get all budget/4 star etc hotel restaurants parks..hiring cars self-driving cars as i stayed at hotel road..and Sidhalepa Ayurveda spa close by and rented self drive car from Advent travels which 5-10 mnts close to mount Lavinia Hotel and delivered car also. recommend stay close to Lavinia where close to safest beach and life guards on duty always..

title: Best beach in Colombo but could be better
text: The beach itself is soft sand but there is litter everywhere which is a shame. There are a couple of places with sunbeds with modest charges. There are a lot of derelict buildings and empty bars etc. Lots of locals use the beach which is great but it does need to be cleaned.

title: Private hotel beach
text: When we went there it was still the monsoon season, the tail end of it, so the beach had red flags. However, there was a nice restaurant/bar right on the beach. They served all types of drinks and freshly made seafood. We had Margaritas and beers with our friends. If you are not staying at the hotel you can a small fee that allows to use their pool as well as the beach.

title: A nice beach.
text: Spent a pleasant afternoon on this beach. A few restaurants to have a meal or drinks. People selling items on the beach. Sand nice and beach clean.

title: Afternoon at the beach
text: Golden sand, ocean very strong, check the signs or ask if it's good to have a bath. The view is perfect and the place is very well equipped with the seafood restaurant, surfs and people to ask informations are really kind.

title: Just an average but dirty beach
text: We were there when it was raining and very windy. The waves were very strong. The sand wasn't fine but still acceptable, but there was quite a fair bit of trash in the section we were at. Do be careful when getting to the beach as one has to cross the train track that runs parallel to the beach.

title: Local Beach
text: It’s a local beach. Nice to see the locals out and about. Definitely not a tourist trap, but somewhat boring... Not recommended.

title: The best!
text: This was the best of the Colombo trip!! Had high-tea here while it was raining. Loved the view/ food/ open sitting and everything about this place!

title: excellent place to have a quite and romantic dinner
text: only 1/2 an hour drive from Colombo city,Excelent fresh sea food, sea side, soothing breeze, amazing feelings.

title: Mount Lavinia
text: We spent several weeks in a Mount Lavinia budget beach hotel eating mostly in a beach restaurant, which was cheep but with descent food and inexpensive beer. It was close to the train track, but it did not bother too much. The sandy beach is very long - not too many people. The nearby Mount Lavinia luxury hotel was much more expensive providing private beach.

title: Not so clean waters
text: More sand in the beach than normal west coast beaches. Could be maintained better. Children had skin allergy after playing in it. Not sure if it on account of the cleanliness of the water. May be because of the drainage water which is let into it nearby.

title: Best beach area in Colombo city
text: Go on early morning or in the evening to spend a relaxing time. I went with my family and my daughter had an awesome time playing on the beach and also playing with water rafts. Collecting different types of sea shells and don't forget to hydrate well with tropical fruit juices available in near by restaurants. Also we loved the Loon tao restaurant near by. Loon Tao is the expensive side but their food and drinks are very good.

title: Could be beautiful but litter strewn
text: Mount Lavinia Beach could be lovely but is not looked after. It is covered in litter and the local people don't seem to notice. It's a real shame, because it could be a great tourist attraction. The Mount Lavinia Hotel is nice and the village is pretty, but spoilt by the unloved beach.

title: An uncrowded beach, perfect venue to unwind at
text: Wish we had spent more time there. The beach was empty which was a good thing. Didn;t walk very far to check out the area, but it seemed like a fun place to relax and spend a nice day swimming and chilling out. Just 15 minutes away from the beach and inside the village, check out the turtle conservation project. Run by a husband and wife, they charge 1000 LKR per head.

title: Relaxed evening.
text: This is the perfect place to rest and relax in the evening till late. The breeze will take away all your tiredness. The place provides tasty dishes. I loved the jumbo prawns and fried Handella. Friendly staff. Little busy over weekends. Try it.

title: Lovely beach and bars by the beach
text: If you have an extra / spare day in Colombo as we did go to Lavinia beach as it’s great scape to enjoy de sun and view the sunset as well Bar are good nice deco and well service

title: A big city beach
text: Sometimes it's quite crowded with local people. The water is not clean as on other beaches in Sri Lanka. Some garbage, not very clean.

title: Nice and clean
text: Nice and clean beach with good service and a great seafood restaurants. One is fish market style, other al local style menus.

title: Afternoon Tea is a 'Must Do' at this lovely hotel
text: We arrived early for a pre-booked afternoon tea and we were allowed to make use of the swimming pool free of charge. They even provided towels! The food and service was first class and thoroughly enjoyable. We liked the taste of the large leaf tea so much that the waitress kindly fetched us an empty packet so that we could buy the correct product.

title: Quiet and amazingly clear water
text: Enjoyed walking up and down the beach while we stayed in Mr. Lavinia Hotel. Quite interesting to see the change from the hotel to the local beach occupied by fisherman's boats. You can do quite a long walk south of Mr. Lavinia Hotel.

title: Nice Evening
text: Sudden plan make me to come here long sleep after tired of long flying time. It was a good place to relax me in a evening. Hope to go again before leaving Srilanka

title: fantastic
text: very nice place to spend hours and hours. many restaurants over there open till midnight and night clubs as well.

title: Pleasant beach but not the cleanest
text: Mount Lavinia Beach (by Mount Laviania Hotel) is a beach of golden sand that is extremely busy with both local people and tourists. The best aspects of it are the sunsets which are wonderful to observe and space to walk adjacent to the sea in this bustling and noisy part of the city. There are numerous places to find drinks, street food and so on. Unfortunately we are saddened by the litter and general messy nature of parts of it. If you are looking for pristine golden sands and peace, there are better places on the island.

title: Sunset and local food
text: Not quite a beach as there is more grass and weed than sand. It's a bit messy, too. Although, it is a fine spot to admire the sunset and have something local to eat.

title: Lots of sand...
text: Very nice beach. Lots of small places to buy a beer, a plate full of fruit or a nice dish of local food. Been there twice, on Independence day. Busy but not overcrowded. The day after that was even quieter with free sunbeds and lots of space. Watch out for the current and big waves when you travel with small children

title: Sunset..by a beach
text: If you love to see the sunset.. capture breathtaking images then a stroll down Mount beach will satisfy you.. this is if you're close to Colombo. Sri Lanka has many many beautiful lookouts.. but this is a good place for a quick drive from the city of Colombo.. walk on the beach.. maybe enjoy a drink and some food from the many restaurants by the beach!

title: Nice quaint older hotel with a posh feeling
text: I had dinner on the beach at the sort-of hide-away restaurant. I ordered appetizers (delicious) and fresh crab (very disappointing). They were out of large crab so I ordered two medium size live crabs which I personally selected. However, when they arrived on my dinner plate, the claws were missing, and it was difficult to be sure I actually got what I ordered. I complained to the staff but I was ensured that what I ordered was what i received. Not so--the claws were missing, for sure. as a consequent, my high-dollar meals provided very little crab meat. My business partner gave me some claw meat from his own plate so I could actually have a meager meal. Do not order medium to small size crab--i think I was not given what I paid for or expected. Sad.

title: Very Very Good.
text: We stayed in Mount Lavinia hotel. Very Expensive. Good Food. Fantastic Experience on last day of our stay in Sri Lanka it was a treat.The beach was quiet and there was staff to be of help all day. Quiet and Peaceful. Good to sit in sun and have a drink in shade of bar. I Love Sri Lanka

title: disappointing beach after seeing others
text: Visited this beach but was disappointed in all the rubbish on it.What does it take for people to tidy up after themselves??Piles of rubbish had been heaped up, but who is going to take it away? Some parts cleaner than others but wouldnt rush to go back

title: Nice sunset Beach
text: Visited the beach in Aug’17. We went in the afternoon and it was quite empty but it did get crowded towards the evening. We watched the sunset and had a small meal at the restaurant. The coconut trees give you some shades and you can hire some beach-chairs. Overall it is OK but there are beautiful beaches in the East and North coast.

title: A huge beach, but not very clean.
text: There are some sections of the beach that are clean, but lots of it isn't! We only saw 1 rubbish bin the whole 7 days we were there & that was overflowing! There is rubbish that has been collected into black bags, but they are not taken away! If the restaurants don't clean their immediate area, then it is not done! The locals & tourists generate a good deal of rubbish that could be recycled if only the infrastructure were in place! It's a shame that this stretch of beautiful beach is marred by flotsum & jetson!

title: Beach at the heart of Colombo
text: Mount Lavinia beach or "Mount" as it's referred to is probably the nicest beach within the confines of Colombo. I, and a group of friends had a few snacks and a lot of drinks at a local beach side bar. The beach is relatively clean, although it could be cleaner. I suspect the odd piece of trash is generated by the numerous bars and restaurants that line the extensive coast line. However, it is still a beautiful spectacle as the beach arches around to the famous Mount Lavinia Beach hotel. It's definitely worth a visit at night to experience the lively atmosphere and to enjoy the company of the locals, who are friendly and welcoming. You can also experience the local wildlife - dogs, cats and crows! I would definitely recommend this beach on any visit to beautiful Sri Lanka.

title: holiday
text: There are plenty of local dogs on the beach . The beach is never swept. Good to swim and have dinner on the beach eating fresh hauls from the sea .

title: Outstanding vibe; questionable water
text: This place was a stone’s throw from my hotel, thus it was frequently visited. It is a very memorable experience to swim here while the sun is setting. As others pointed out, the water is not the cleanest. Upon walking a few hundred metres up the beach, I noticed that a stormwater drain/sewer (?) drains straight into the water. Alarmingly, there was an oil spill one afternoon, unbeknownst to the swimmers already in the water! Oil was left in the sand, and was visible in the crashing waves. Yuck. There are countless nicer beaches in Sri Lanka, however, this is worth the visit for its location. In the evening, locals pack the beach, creating a very lively atmosphere.

title: We had a nice day.
text: Six English tourists aged between 11-60 visiting on a Tuesday afternoon. Beach easily reached by tuk tuk. Half an hour from Galle Face Hotel. We had a drink in a newly refurbished bar with a white picket fence, was clean, good service and comfortable, with sunbeds. Walked along beach to Mount Lavinia Hotel. You can’t access the hotel from the beach unless your a resident. Walk along the train track and up through main entrance. Ate lunch on the terrace, then jumped in a tuk tuk. Beach was quiet, no boats for hire, one stall selling balls ect. A handful of beach bars. Nice sand, lovely locals, but a little bit of litter. You could catch the train from here near the hotel. We worked out they seemed to come about every 45 minutes.

title: A nice bech
text: It is a clean beach with many restaurants. It is a great beach to swim or go fo a nice walk. There are people selling souvenirs, but they do not hassle you too much.

title: Beautiful
text: Have been here several times now & have never been disappointed . Meal as always beautiful , the service fantastic. Love the old colonial building & the views are great .

title: What a lovely beach
text: A perfect place for a lazy sunday afternoon and then watch the nice sunset. it offers a wide variety of seafood restaurants and bars to enjoy the evening as well.

title: Safe beach, lots of families but come back before dark
text: The beach was safe, waves not too big, great to see families out in force having fun. Lots of places to stop if you walk *towards* Mount Lavinia Hotel. Don't walk the other direction

title: Serene beach
text: This beach is an hour away from Colombo city. There are a lot of restaurants and bars alongside the beach. Good for walking!

title: Nice walk on the beach
text: A very nice clean beach with lots of food and drink to stop for... Can walk or sunbathe.. The sea can be a little rough at times, but as long as you are careful should be fine..

title: Very nice
text: Our hotel has very best private beach. Clean, has showers. Couple of restaurants, no locals. We went for New Years Holidays, it was perfect. Mild waves.

title: Pleasant location
text: Clean and well organised place. Of course good location as it is attached to the very nice hotel. You can find really tasty and well cooked food or directly on the beach, or in the hotel. Service was also fast.

title: Beaches In srilanka
text: It's a nice beach. Full of fun and parties. At night there are dance parties near beach. Might be the good place for sea food lover

title: Beautiful sunset
text: Beautiful sunset over the Indian ocean especially so when there is cloud & you can see sun rays as the sun sets over the horizon. Manage to view double rainbow as the sky opens up with a short shower.

title: Unfortunately quite scruffy...
text: Sorry to say we were not impressed with this beach it was quite scruffy and there are a lot of places just full of rubbish... Could be nice if locals made an effort to give it a good tidy....

title: Nice beach, but not unique.
text: It was a nice enough place to walk on the beach, but there wasn't a whole lot going on there. I did see a few restaurants around and there were some locals with fishing boats, which is a nice cultural touch. I think there are probably some nicer beaches on the island, but if you're in Colombo and looking for a place to see the water, then this will work.

title: Sea side
text: My wife and I stayed for 3 nights on our journey to Sri Lanka. We really enjoyed our room / direct sea view on the 4th floor. I approached the manager and booked another 4 nights after our trip to Kandy. I must say he was very helpful and we had the same room on our return. Over a great stay and nice hotel for a relaxing holiday

title: Nice place. Beach ok. Jojo Food vendor bad experience
text: Overall beach is nice. However it was bit crowded when i went on sunday. Beach sand quality was not too good as it was black at some places. Plus the jojo food vendor experience was pretty bad. 4 star for the beach.

title: Most important for me it is very clean !
text: A beautiful beach next to the railway station and approx 30 mins drive from central Colombo - the place had a nice vibe and topography with a number of local restaurants and bars to relax and enjoy the view. Considering this is a "city beach" it was very clean. On the other side of the railway tracks is a busy suburb with lots of shopping options (big and small) and restaurants etc

title: excellent sea view
text: well maintained hotel , good food and service , the sea view from the restaurant is amazing, a must visit place

title: Fantastic hotel full of character -Tarick
text: The staff at the Mount Lavinia were so welcoming and always happy to help you. The hotel has some beautiful surroundings and is perfect to relax before trips out later. A member of staff named Tarick was kind enough to show us around the hotel and always greeted us with a warm welcome. Seeing Staff happy to see you makes your stay feel so special. VIP tours are also based there and offer plenty of information on trips you may wish to go on. Himari has been fantastic in organising our tour around Sri Lanka. Thank you Tarick and the staff of Mount Lavinia.

title: Beautiful place to see the sunset.
text: We went here 3-4 times. But all times there was no season here to swim. Anyway I would like not to swim in Colombo. But to sit and enjoy sea cove restaurant on the beach - this is must have.

title: Gets very busy in the evenings
text: Nice beach comparatively bigger than ones in Colombo. Fairly clean, waters can be a bit rough. Some nice restaurants along the beach. Good for jogging or long walks or even a dip during the calmer seasons. The beach gets very crowded in the evenings so better chances of enjoying more during mornings or afternoons. Keep an eye on personal belongings as some dodgy folk do tend to hang around.

title: ok had a couple of drinks at one of the bars it was ok, nothing special.
text: went there for an afternoon drink and a walk on the beach. Had a nice atmosphere on the beach, customer service was ok. not great, had to wait a while for our order?

title: Excellent night and performance
text: I got the opportunity to visit Mount Lavinia Beach on the business trip. I visited this place along with my colleagues and we spent a perfect musical night here. The performance from the local team was excellent and having a group dinner with top management team was memorable.

title: Lunch on the beach
text: The hotel is a throw back to a previous Colonial life and is an oasis in a hustling bustling city. The swimming pool is child friendly and it also has access to a beach where a variety of beach food is available - including freshly cooked, freshly caught sea food. Nice but the Galle Face hotel is so much nicer.

title: Mountlavina Nice beach
text: Nice beach & beautiful sunset. There some places parties at night . it is good place having fresh sea food . not so good for swimming, snorkeling because currents in this month.

title: Filthy
text: Very unclean... Just awful rubbish everywhere Restaurant lacking in hygiene standards To many hawkers interrupting dinner

title: A Good Sea Beach!
text: Mount Lavinia Beach is located just out of the Colombo city, it took long time to go there from our hotel located in the Colombo city Centre. It’s a nice place to roaming around the sea side with sands. The beach was not crowded during our visit, it was very hot and humid day. One can see the Mount Lavania Hotel from the beach, which is one of the oldest renowned hotel in Colombo. There are some Sea Fish restaurants available beside the beach. One can also enjoy famous Srilankan coconut water from the small shops near the beach.

title: Lovely place but dangerous
text: Beautiful beach. But the sea is treacherous with under currents. Being a resident of the area we have seen so many deaths due to drowning. Humbly request all visitors NOT to get into water but enjoy the beach.

title: Loved this Beach
text: I got here just before the sunset and I was awe-inspired to see the beautiful sunset it had to offer. One can get here by train or can simply take any southbound bus from Colombo and get down here. Transports to and from Colombo are frequently available from here. I would recommend people to get to this beach just fir its brilliant sunset. Would love to go back there someday.

title: Routine beach
text: Just like any other beach. Few fast food corners along the beach. Few people taking a dip in the warm waters. Mostly sandy with few rocks. Best thing is life guards on duty with watch towers along the beach.

title: South end of beach OK
text: As long as you walk the South end of the beach it's OK. Further North passed the fishermen it gets a bit smelly. Enjoyed watching the fishermen bringing in their catch

title: Late night outing
text: Really nice seating arrangements. Impressive collection of fresh seafood. Loved the multilingual singers on the beach. Food was of highest quality and taste. One if the best place to have a candle night dinner right on the beach. A must destination during colombo visit

title: Great seaside view
text: A great place to view the sunset while having a couple of beers. There are many restaurants along the beach you can choose.

title: Not a relaxing experience.
text: I arrived in Negombo around 9am, as it was too early to check in to my hotel I dumped my bag and headed to the beach to explore. From the moment I set foot onto the beach I was continuously hounded by numerous locals, each trying to sell me something - either a boat trip, or various wares they were trying to flog. I just wanted to be left alone, explore, feel the sun on my skin, and enjoy the views. But I didn’t get one minutes peace. After about half an hour I’d had enough and left the beach. Yes, they’re relatively friendly, but it’s just damn annoying! When one of them is talking to you, you can see about four or five other vendors circling, waiting for them to leave, so they can then pounce. Not a good experience, unfortunately.

title: Not a nice beach
text: The beach is so dirty, full of rubbish with what looks like an oil spill.. such a Health hazard........... .....................................................

title: Local beach
text: Very windy local beach. The sea is not one of the best in Sri Lanka, but the atmosphere is beautiful. Characteristic on weekends, full of local people who come here to swim and spend a day at the beach.

title: Head for the South Coast beaches instead!
text: Much more of a locals beach, not any amenities and not very clean. Not great for sunbathing and anything, we just walked up and down in 5 minutes!

title: Will not rush back
text: Looks great, golden sands, fishing boats, locals playing, lovely breeze. Lots of traders, but friendly and polite when you say no thank you. Lots of litter and a bit like a scene from Alfred Hitchcock The crow. They are everywhere and it feels as if they are watching you. Roosting time is eerie.

title: Dreadful pollution
text: Looking forward a nice long walk on the beach which looked lovely from the hotel - an hour I’ll never get back. Black oil under the sand, extensive rubbish, dead turtle ??, plastic and rubbish everywhere...

title: Power Cuts and uncared for mess
text: Writing in early March 2022 the main issue is power cuts. I have travelled all over SL in the last 2 months, from Jaffna to Tangalle and the only place I have stayed with long daily power cuts is Negombo. Fine if you're in one of the characterless hotels like Jetwings etc. with their noisey diesel generators. But no fun for the majority staying at smaller more environmentally friendly hotels and guest houses. And the beach is filthy. This is the town most tourists visit on the way in and out of the country. Not a good impression.

title: Negombo Garbage Beach Clean it up!!
text: The locals should be ashamed. The beach is littered with plastic and junk . Cant blame it on the tourists because there are hardly any here. If the locals want tourists to come, then they need to treat their own backyard with more dignity. So bad and such a disappointment. Plus the sea is rough and brown. If coming to Sri Lanka, choose elsewhere on the island.

title: I never come back!
text: We planned to spend one day at the beach before leaving home. As soon as we arrived at the beach our minds changed. The beach was full of all kinds of rubbish and the sea water was brown. The whole beach area looked like that locas were using it as dump. There are so many nice beaches in Sri Lanka but this was just huge dissapointment!

title: Garbage site
text: Filthy. The entire beach / all of Negombo is basically Sri Lanka's garbage disposal. The beach itself is littered with rubbish to the extent where every other step is on a bottle or some plastic bags etc. Bizarrely you find some residents of the hotels going to swim in the sea here. Can't understand why, as the sea is brown. Also beware the beggars and scammers. Would not recommend at all... Go far, far away from smelly Negombo

title: Quiet Beach ...
text: This is a quieter beach front as compared to the Galle Face Beach. A nice place to relax on the beach; enjoy the sea breeze; enjoy the sunset view with peaceful surroundings. We were told by our driver/ guide that Negombo is usually a starting point or ending point of Sri Lanka trip since it is closer to the International Airport. We were so glad that we made Negombo as our last destination during our Sri Lanka Trip as it is indeed a relaxing place to end the trip after the extensive tour around Sri Lanka Island.

title: Wide quiet beach
text: Great beach facing the west so sunset photos over the ocean. Opportunity to swim in the Indian Ocean- warm and inviting. Jetwing Blue is right on Negombo Beach.

title: Beautiful beach
text: Negombo beach is really nice some nice bars that lead onto the beach itself great location, watch out for seller's there are quite a lot walking up and down the beach but you can get a bargain just as I did. Mr D Meadows

title: Nice but not as pretty as others
text: The beach is long and goes on for miles. Very relaxed beach but the undercurrent in the sea can be deceiving on some days, but if you can swim, you will be fine. We enjoyed it but would have liked to have seen more shacks on the beach with sunbeds which would have been a nice addition.

title: good for 1 night before taking my flight
text: Last year I also was in Sri Lanka and I spent my last night in a big hotel at the airport. This year looking better at the map I discovered that Negombo beach is not fare, so we decided to spend our last night here. The beach is not clean, but anyhow we took a long walk on the beach. we really enjoyed our night at Bacco Italian Restaurant eating great food and a bottle of good wine.

title: Dirty beach with potential
text: I recommend cleaning this beach. Lots of plastic crap and dirty water. It could be way nicer with a cleanup.

title: Clean pristine!
text: It's a pristine sea face definitely worth a visit. They offer catamaran rides that we didn't try though.

title: Walk along the beach
text: Nice sand beach, but no sun beds anywhere around. There are also some annoying sellers going around the beach selling bracelets and fishing trips. Nice place to go for a walk.

title: Lovely beach
text: Stayed in goldi sands hotel right on the beach from with a sea view of this beautiful beach. Morning is very pea full all you can hear are the birds and see squirrels running around in the trees. Afternoon the you see people chilling on the beach then in the early evening it comes to life with locals play volley ball, football and even weddings. Lovely to just sit and watch the world go by

title: Terrible place
text: Avoid! DIRTY!!! Go to the south if you want nice turquoise waters and clean sand. the water is sandy and the sand is not cleaned. You find almost anything on that beach, unfortunately! Public beach left uncleaned and unattended.

title: A fisherman’s beach
text: Fairly clean, probably 100 metres wide. High rise hotels. The beach drops steeply into the sea. I wouldn’t recommend it as a swimming beach. Traditional fishing boats and swarthy fishing folk. Faces west so good for sunsets.

title: No beach loungers
text: Nice wide beach with golden sand but beach loungers is not a thing on this side of the world. Not a private beach so you do get vendors trying to sell merchandise and tours but not overly aggressive. Warm very warm and was calm.
