title: Nothing much to do..
text: Rough waves , deep ocean and nothing much to do on this beach. Negombo has nothing much to do or see around. Prices here are high compared to mirissa. Good place for a one night or two. However you feel bored after couple of nights. Choose wisely. Good eating joints like lords and serendib pub.

title: Very nice and adventurous
text: I visited brown beach. It was beautiful but less managed so looked little messy as compared to other beaches. It is having little steep shores therefore the waves are little deeper and higher, though it may not look so in photographs. It's has restaurants and hotels nearby. Go ahead and enjoy.

title: Quiet and opportune
text: Easy going with a few pedlars but a wide beach good for riding in a local skiff, a dip (mind the tow), fishing, beach soccer, volleyball, cricket, sun-bathing, a drink or meal.

title: A NICE STRETCH OF SAND
text: There are apparently better beaches to the north of the town but the one opposite the town proper is more than suitable for a walk or a short dip. You will probably see some oruwas, a catamaran that uses hollowed out trees as its base. It is little wonder all the fishermen you see are thin. Cap off the day with a sunset over the Indian Ocean.

title: Wind swept beach with drains emptying onto ocean
text: Close to airport, so Negambo worth an overnight stay or two. We srrived on full moon so fun to see locals enjoying beach. Beach not idyllic so don't come for yhe beach go to Mirissa.

title: Stop over for few days
text: We were in Tangalle where beaches are exceptional. This is a town beach, with open drains flowing into sea, I didn't swim here. Busy stretches quiet spots can be found. Only one place Sea look to stretch out on a lounger. There are areas of rubbish on beach but not everywhere it is a town beach. Beach vendors but they are usually quite polite. Sunset and long cool drink, must do....

title: Hectic in the evenings
text: a large beach with lots going on especially in the late afternoon when it cools down. Boat trips are fun as the speed boats fly straight up the beach when coming into land. music and dancing going on and a small market for street food etc.. trouble is the locals don't respect what they have and tend to leave a lot of rubbish around which is a shame.

title: Large but dirty
text: Went to the beach for xmas holidays and it was pretty crowded with locals which is fine but they threw thrash everywhere. It is a large beach with grainy yellow sand, but unfortunately several insisting salesperson trying hard to make you buy bracelets while talking about money to support his kids. So not a place to chill - I went once and never again.

title: Family trip
text: Good beach, well maintained. Neatly maintained. Public behavior is good. Friendly fishermen. Nicely decorated hotel backyards.

title: Good
text: This beautiful beach is close to the main Katunayake airport. This is a good beach. This popular with locals and tourists.

title: Dirty and too wide
text: Nothing like the smaller, cozy beaches in the south. Also it's dirty, very wide with very big waves and not really welcoming at all. Good for a quick stay before going or coming from the airport.

title: Hallo madam, hallo?
text: ‘Hallo madam. Hallo? Hallo?’ is what you will hear all the time while trying to relax after a swim in the see. One after the other sellers will offer various products and won’t leave you alone until you don’t tell them at least three times ‘thank you, I’m not interested in buying anything’. Then they will insist on at least showing you their collection of goodies. After the second day, I used the ‘hello, no thank you, I’m not interested’ even before they would approach me. Sometimes it worked, sometimes it didn’t. As for the beach, it’s extremely dirty, there is trash literally everywhere! There is no shade where one could hide and since the water is full of sand, your swimwear will be also! If you happen to wear a bikini, be prepared to receive some stares because local women go in the water with their clothes on.

title: Good for a short visit
text: Beach can be crowded in evening. Strong waves but people enjoying. Did not see any lifeguards. Lots of small food stalls all selling the same stuff-fried fish, prawns,potato,etc. Too many crows during evening make it not nice at times. Enough parking space which is paid, several big restaurants also present nearby.

title: Most Underrated Beach in Asia
text: Many travellers may not know that Maldives and Sri Lanka both shares the Indian Ocean. Negombo Beach is a long beautiful stretch of white sand by the ocean. The sunset is superbly beautiful. You can also ride on the traditional catamaran!

title: Last day
text: Went for a walk on our last day in srilanka beautiful to spend the day by watching the sunset had some chat with the locals who stayed on the beach on that time. nice beach to spend the last day

title: Ok
text: I would not swim In the sea as raw sewage is discharged in to the waters. I agree with this statement. If you want to get sick swim in the sea. The resturant was please take enough but over priced for what it was

title: Nice beach
text: Very nice beach, water not very clean but perfect for walks and watching crabs :) Not many places on the beach itself so it makes for a rare view of quite untouched beach with palm trees.

title: Not a lot to see or do. Mostly dirty.
text: Since our flight was landing midnight at Colombo airport, we decided to give Negombo a try as it was closer to the airport than Colombo. The only thing worth doing in Negombo was the beach so we decided to head to the beach after having our breakfast. The beach is very small and mostly dirty. You will be troubled with people trying to lure you for a pathetic boat ride. This beach is mostly for locals. There are some local snacks shops and ice cream trucks here. Most of the beach is tarred with trash and after every 20 meters someone will approach you for boat ride or try to sell you something. That's another buzzkill. You can spend around half an hour to one hour here but nothing more. We found beaches in Bentota much better than Negombo.

title: Not too bad
text: The beach at Negombo is just ok. There is a lot of rubbish on the beach but most of it is cleaned up each morning by a tractor. Even after the clean up there is still a far bit I’d waste left. You would only go to this beach if you are staying in one of the hotels along it after or before your flight. It’s not a place I would visit for the beach alone. In saying that we swam there each day we were there. The water was pretty good in the mornings but by the afternoon there was a lot of debris floating in it. It’s not the kind of beach where you go and lay on it like we do in Australia. The sand is course and there is the rubbish issue. The other thing to contend with are the hawkers trying to sell your their wares and the boat owners wanting to take you for a boat trip. It’s an ok beach if you are there but don’t go out of your way to visit.

title: Not the best...
text: After coming from the Maldives, any beach would pale in comparison. However; there was lots of litter on the beach, and we had to consistently have to say "no" to the hoards of people trying to sell us nick nacks.

title: Clean
text: The beach is a little different to those on Aussie shores. It gets cleaned daily, is frequented by hawkers and there are lots of stray dogs. The dogs won’t bother you. The hawkers will. However, they are a polite nation and are just trying to earn a living. If you’re not interested, a polite no is all it takes. The sea is incredibly warm but those waves are strong so please watch out for your little ones.

title: Beach
text: There is t loads to do at the beach other than sit on the sand as there are no chairs other than with the hotels

title: Can be boring!
text: Golden sand beach, normally completely empty without most of the things necessary to enjoy a beach, unless you are in one the hotel’s with entrance to the beach. Lack of things to do. Lack of activities, restaurants, etc.

title: Slightly Disappointed
text: I definitely expected a little more from that beach, though the sunsets were beautiful. The sand was more of a brownish color, and not as soft as I thought.

title: Lovely beach
text: I love the beach. It’s quite clean and there’s a play area for kids too. Go out into the sea and check out the ‘shipwreck’ and the corals.

title: A few dead cats
text: We stayed in Negombo for one night for our layover. The beach was nice, however, we had a dead cat wash up ashore right in front of us and a few meters down another dead dried up cat from the sun. As you can probably tell the beach wasn’t very clean. Otherwise beautiful views.

title: A little hmmm
text: Whilst it good for a stroll, there is just too much litter for me. The sand is a light brown and slightly coarse. The are a few polite touts to keep you on your toes.

title: Health Hazard
text: A beautiful stretch of beach several miles long completely ruined by the amount of rubbish strewn across the whole length of it. Plastic of all descriptions from tooth brushes to old toys, and of course many many plastic bottles. Also glass bottles whole and smashed, as well as other detritus. Yet worse than this from the wild life perspective is the bits of old fish nets and lines scattered all over the place. A real danger to all forms of marine life. Feral dogs run loose and defecate everywhere, worse still my wife witnessed a local also defecating on the edge of the water. A half-hearted attempt is made to clean the beach by use of a tractor and sand scoop but does not cover even half the beach leaving most of the beach untouched. Saw one so called recycling bin that was used as a general rubbish bin, apart from that there appears no attempt to recycle any of this mess. At one point a stream runs across the beach then out to sea that smells strongly of sweage . There is also a small pond that also smells the same. All the beach bars and hotels that front onto this stretch of sand serve all their drinks with plastic straws and there are thousands of them every where you look on what should be a lovely natural space. So if you do walk on this beach keep your saddles on

title: Dirty
text: Negombo is a sandy beach with muddy waters. No shade to be found. Only got approached by one seller. This beach needs a clean, dead cats and rubbish filtering into the sea .

title: Vendors can be annoying
text: Negombo Beach is actually quite long. Our first encounter was on a Sunday near the Jetwing Hotel as the sun was setting. We saw local families packing up, preparing to head home. Groups of young men playing beach volleyball and others kicking a soccer ball around. A few female vendors approached us but we said "no thank you" and they left us alone. Two weeks later, we walked to the beach in the morning near the Heritance Hotel and were immediately barraged by people offering tours, boat rides, and souvenirs. We had wanted to take a nice quiet stroll by the water but left after 10 minutes because it got unbearably annoying because the vendors kept following us. The sand itself is a tan color and the water seemed clean. Not the powdery soft white sand and crystal blue clear water that we associate with the South Pacific.

title: Very clean beach
text: Great beach to swim in and very clean. Fantastic sunsets. Very romantic setting for couples. Children can play freely and there are always locals on the beach playing volleyball and softball and they always enjoy foreigners joining in.

title: nice beach shame about the plastic
text: really nice beach to wander on - just a issue we had with the amount of drift plastic washed up most of it not created in sri lanka but brought here by the indian ocean - a shame clean up operations do not seem to be in place would make it a wonderful destination

title: Negombo Beach is a treasure!
text: We stayed at the IceBear Guesthouse on Negombo Beach (direct access to this beach for its residents). The beach is fairly clean and was never crowded. The fisherman further up the beach were friendly (as were the locals) and prepared to pose for photos if you asked politely and showed them the results "in camera".

title: Negombo beach
text: Very lovely and neat sea front . You can walk along in the white sand often waves touching your feet. But very windy some days and should be careful.

title: Wild beach
text: This beach is good to be seen from far and enjoyed. I am sure it is uneven beach and tides are pretty heavy so risky to jump in the water. But sun set on the beach is beautiful.

title: Litter spoiled our beach experience
text: As an Australian family are expectations are higher than some countries, but you would have to blind not to notice the amount of litter on the beach here. We didn’t swim. Nice sand texture a long beach but disappointing.

title: nice beach
text: i would like to tell you that negombo beach is very nice place to visit.restaurants arround the beach are so. Cleanly.fresh and delicious seafood can taste arround the beach restaurants.

title: Golden Sand Beach
text: This beach is known for its golden sand where many tourist both foreign and locals visits specially during weekends. I just hope people could do more to keep the beach more clean for everybody to enjoy.

title: One of the excellent Beach at Indian Ocean shores
text: Negombo sandy Beach is clean. The water is warm and clean as well. To my surprise the sea birds are not visible at Negombo. The most popular are angry crocks birds.

title: Good for the day but very busy
text: The beach is very busy in the afternoon but it is nice, with good weather. A bit dirty so make sure you don’t litter!

title: Not the best beach but good place to hang out before you depart to Colombo airport
text: We arrived into Colombo area for our departure flight back home and had some time to kill so we headed to Negombo (hearing it was a nice way to relax before leaving Sri Lanka). The beaches were full of litter and were no where as pristine as some of the other beaches we visited. There are very expensive restaurants (relative to what we had paid for 2 weeks during out travels around Sri Lanka) that line the beach which are really your only options for food. Overall it was a good way to kill time before we had to depart for our 11pm flight but if you can avoid it with other more interesting activities would recommend skipping.

title: Beach
text: Very beautiful attractive beach.. I enjoyed it as one of the most amazing beaches in the world. Sri lankan people are very friendly and helpful.

title: Woow beach...!! Should vist again...
text: I wish i live there entire life of mine. That's a beacb you would die for. I wish i can spend my retirement in srilanka close to the beach.. Such a scenery beach

title: Nice beach with lots of places to eat nearby.
text: I arrived at Negombo beach at 1 pm ... The beach had lots of boats on the shore... There were plenty of beach side resorts and a few restaurants on the beach to grab something to eat... Due to hide tide starting in frst week of may it wasn’t preferable to swim but still you can enjoy the ocean views from a distance. The shore of the beach was not that clean but i had a nice time just taking pictures with the boats and hanging around for a while.... i didn’t spend more then an 2 hours near the beach.....

title: Walked Negombo Beach
text: I would't call it the most beautiful but we enjoy visiting beaches from around the world. This happened to be one.

title: Nice beach
text: A nice beach, some nice bars and restaurants to get refreshments if you want. Beach is sandy and quite wide. Lots of families swimming so assume a good place, although didn’t swim ourselves

title: not so clear during the off season
text: I was just here for a couple of days and there was a fair amount of garage on the beach. Maybe during the tourist season they clean it up. While running I went north, running along the street, until I could cut in to Browns Beach, which was cleaner.

title: A dirty beach
text: Not a place to lounge around to catch rays. It was a dirty beach and had locals trying to sell you beaded jewellery or sarongs. There are better beaches South of the island.

title: Don’t waste more than a day
text: I spent my last day & a half here & although I enjoyed it (somewhat) I wouldn’t waste more than a day. Parts of the beach I might describe as nice but then there were other parts particularly around the fishing boats where there was a lot of plastic & other litter strewn about which made it all look sad. The locals just don’t seem to notice it. Some good value restaurants along the main strip though.

title: No need to stick around
text: Good place to stay before or after a flight but as far as Sri Lanka’s beaches are... don’t waste time here.

title: Decent beach with nice bars
text: Spent a few days on the beach whilst staying in Negombo with my then girlfriend. It's a nice enough beach to relax on and/or have a swim. There are also a few bars dotted along the beach that also serve food. We spent a couple of evenings sipping on some Lions and watching the sunset

title: Negombo best beach
text: The negombo beach is the best beach I have recently visited . This is my first time in Srilanka and the 1st place I visited is the beach. Its beautiful tranquil and calm though its hot I enjoyed it very much

title: Food.
text: I have been here maybe 25 times and the restaurant must be the best in Sri Lanka.. if you like Sri Lanka stile, spicy mmmm Karin and me love it!

title: Beautiful, but dirty
text: Beautiful beach, but very dirty. We had trouble finding a decent enough space to sunbathe. Also the locals are sometimes quite agressive in trying to sell you stuff. We had to be pretty rude ourselves in order to get some peace. But if you’re there, make sure to catch the sunset. Quite spectacular.

title: Quit dirty
text: Very dirty and not so nice sand. Sometimes beautiful sunsets. Not possible to make long beach walks because sometimes you cant cross the vegetation

title: wonderful beach, nice people
text: The beach is lovely the sand is so warm to walk on. I enjoyed my time here walking. And evening strolls.The seas were very rough and it was impossible to swim.

title: negombo beach srilnaka
text: the beach is very wide with attached hotels and restaurants, safety measures not found. tide comes with slopy surface which is not good for kids and those who are good in swimming. sand is reasonable. provision of washrooms, pre/post bathing are available or not appropriate in general

title: Nice beach
text: We visited here for 3 days and we thought with all the reviews that the beach wasn’t very nice. we thought differently, we enjoyed a few walks along the beach with the stray dogs and unique boats. The only down point was the people trying to sell you items, too many of them chasing you down or when you stop to get food they are waiting for you and shouting across to buy something.

title: Great spot to watch the locals play cricket
text: Not the best beach for swimming but great spot for watching the local kids play cricket and fly kites, also nice for sunsets.

title: A leisurly beach walk....
text: ....Was a great way to start, and end, the day. I enjoyed putting my toes in the sand and feeling the waves on my feet. I felt safe on my beach walks.

title: Great beach, long stretches of sand, nice water temps and we enjoyed the swimming. Just the plastic trash.
text: This would beach would have got a much higher rating if it wasnt for the amount if plastic and trash you found washed up along the shore, and in the water. Everytime we swam (4 days, twice a day) we were guarenteed to get plastic and rubbish wraped around our legs or stuck to us. Sri lanka would be a perfect place if it wasnt for pollution.

title: beach is good for walks but not sun bathing
text: this beach is not recommended for sun bathing as it has lots of garbage all over place. recommended only for walks and experiencing the fishing community. the only places with a clean piece of sand are those in front of the large hotels. the best beaches are in the south and east coasts.

title: Part of the beach is OK, lots of rubbish unfortunately I lots of places
text: I think our hotel cleans the beach area around us. The beach could be very nice as soon as they clean it up, everywhere.

title: Wide beach but little to do
text: You do not want to stay in Negombo for a longer period of time. One night will suffice. Recover from your flight and get away from here. The beach in Negombo is wide but there is very little to do. Travel on...

title: Full of plastic and garbage.
text: Really sad to see how people treat nature. A walk on the beach feels like walking on a trash field. The hotel owners keep their little part clean, however plastic bottles and other garbage just wash straight in to the sea from the rest of the beach. This will damage the fish (they eat), other sea life and the view. The beach is full of crows picking the garbage. I really hope that the government, hotels and local community will step up their game! If they don’t do it for nature than hopefully they do it for tourism, because not a tourist in this world likes to walk on a beach this dirty, horrible!

title: Lots of waves
text: I was only walking on the beach. I haven’t spotted anyone dip into the ocean. There are some spots with lot of garage and some without any rubbish. The water seems to be rough so this might be a reason why there was nobody or maybe because of the climate then.

title: Very local beach!
text: We originally thought that this beach was very touristy, but they are many more locals then tourists at this place. You can buy fried shrimps, and other types of fried food at a very cheap price from stands on the beach. The beach is fairly clean, with some plastic lying around. Great place to see the sunset.

title: Dirty beech covered in plastic.
text: Such a shame this one. Ruined by rubbish washed up on beach. This is such a lovely place and the people are fantastic. Just spoiled by the rubbish.

title: Average beach
text: Nothing to shout about. Not really a beach for swimming. There are events held on the beach over the weekend. Lots of stray dogs.

title: Nothing special - best viewed from a pool!
text: Pretty average but best experienced by a hotel pool. We are glad to have stayed in Negombo instead of Colombo though.

title: Good for a stroll
text: Negombo beach is good to walk off the jet lag, but isn’t the prettiest. There’s a bit of construction going on, but it was reasonably tidy. Best of all, it was hot and sunny!

title: Most relaxed
text: Loved the beach for its cleanliness and relaxation. I only have been there for three days but definitely looking forward to the next time I get to be there.

title: Peaceful............
text: A beach very popular with local fisherman, Relaxing to take a walk as the sun sets. Beware beach traders,not to be trusted!!!!

title: Fishermen's beach
text: A nice beach where you can take a walk and watch the beautiful sunset. You will also get to see local fishermen doing their daily fishing routine.

title: Nice Beach
text: Very busy beach on weekends with locals, great sunset views! Street food available from many stalls. Families tend to come here to relax and swim.

title: Nice place for a walk on the beach
text: Ideal place for a walk/run on the beach. Should you target a surfing place, I would rather recommend the southern part of the country (Merissa)

title: Few days rest after 2 weeks travel through sri lanka
text: Very nice, people are very kind. Catamaran sailing was top. Food is wonderfull. A lot to see. Rent a bike

title: Great vacation spot!
text: Sri Lanka is still up and coming as a tourist spot, so Negombo is luckily relatively unspoiled. Really enjoyed it here!

title: Good beach with various options
text: This is quite good a beach where one can wet the feet or wade in to the water or simply walk around. Entertainment options include sea trips in speed boats wind surfing and yachting. They ask for a bomb as a fee to the tourists but are open to any kind of bargaining and negotiations, Good option in Negombo area especially when small children in the group

title: Good beach
text: Beach is used actively by fishermen and it’s great to watch them hauling in their catch. Local catamaran trips are a great way to get up close and see fishermen at work. Beach is clean with usual driftwood etc and not full of plastic as others have said.

title: nice beach to walk

title: Don't bother
text: Just had a quick stroll along a short part of the beach and that was enough. Quite dirty and litter strewn.On the plus side there quite a few restaurants/bars there but steer clear of the beach.

title: Dirty and Rough
text: We visited in August and the sea was very rough as it is at this time of the year. The beach is dirty with the odd hotel scattered between shanty building. Negombo is good for a stop over after a flight, however only stay for one night. There is not much else worth seeing here and there are much nicer beaches.

title: Last days in country
text: Beach is a mess and strewn with litter so in our view not worth visiting. There are a variety of local bars and cafes along the main road, those we tried were ok.

title: Lovely unspoilt beach
text: We stayed at the Moon Isle Beach Bungalows on the beach and it was simply stunning. Gorgeous sea and lovely sand that was not too spoilt by the typical litter of the region

title: Outstanding Beachfront Hotel
text: Beautiful hotel, I had a sea view cottage and was made so welcome here the food is amazing and you are so well looked after. The manager is always at breakfast greeting you and always checking if all is good with you in the evening, long hours! Everyone was super friendly, they have an amazing pool, the beach is perfection and the Hotel is very well maintained, because it is well run. All the grounds are maintained and picture perfect. Nilaveli Crab dinner at the beach bar was sublime. They have a shuttle bus that got me safely back to the international airport at a good price, thank you. You can book diving, I think they are about to in house a dive school which would be even better.

title: Laid back vibe
text: Beautiful beach, white sand, stretches as far as the eye can see, fishermen bringing in the daily catch, shallow calm water. A liytle.corner of paradise!!! Beware of the argumentative black dogs though!

title: Nilaveli ???????? ????????
text: Scenic sandy beach featuring clear water with coral & marine life & boats to Pigeon Island. Quite, amazing and very clean beach

title: Best beach on East Coast of Sri Lanka
text: Clean beach with many palm trees, good restaurant and close to Pigeon Island where you can admire beautiful reefs. Highly recomend

title: Nilaveli Beach off-season reviewed
text: This is a long beach some 8km long. Roughly in the middle there is a little grid of roads that stretch from the main road to the beach, with a number of restaurants and guesthouses. Most Sri Lankan visitors swim here and there is a 400m or so clean stretch of sand with lifeguards. South (towards Trinco) of this stretch there is a bit of plastic litter on the beach.This worsens after about 1km to the extent that you wouldn't want to walk further let alone swim. You can't directly walk North along the beach as there is a naval training facility. Beyond that there is a short decent stretch of sand in front of a couple of smart hotels (there is also a ticket booth for Pigeon Island here.) Further North the beach is pretty filthy. I would guess things would be better in-season as more hotels would make more of an effort and, I'm guessing, the prevailing winds might be from a better direction. All along the beach the shore shelves in gently so its shallow a long way out and the waves aren't too big.

title: Plastic plastic plastic
text: Like other places plastic is a problem. Beach in front of hotel is public and almost clean. Wild dogs and cows may be on the beach.

title: Great Beach
text: This was a lovely beach and you could swim at any time of the day. The beach itself was really clean with no rubbish and the water was clean and resfreshing. The town had everything you would need and was an interesting place however this is the only place in Sri Lanka where we saw rubbish on the side of the roads and in the housing areas Karen M

title: Filthy
text: Oh my gosh, plastic everywhere along this beach ??, cows poo ?? everywhere and buses driving fast down the small roads leading to the beach. Reconsider to look for a cleaner place

title: There are many access points – choose wisely!
text: The beach is long and there are many places to get onto it. There is one access point north of the Navy station. It’s lovely, very European but has no shade (unless you’re staying at the Anilana or Nilaveli beach hotel). The public beach just south of the Navy place is where the boats go to Pigeon island from. It has lifeguards so it’s good for those unable to swim. Muslims would feel comfortable here as many bathe in clothing. there is a cafÃ© called mamma Mia that has lounger platforms for free. Further south from this beach the water doesn’t smell so strongly of diesel fumes from the outboard motors. You can walk for 4 kilometres walk down to bliss bay hotel at the far end. There are a few cafÃ©s along the beach.

title: Nice and clean sandy beach
text: We stayed 4 nights to rest in a resort right on the beach. The beach is very wide, clean and sea was easily swimmable. Super place to rest!

title: Family sunbath
text: Wide beach .long.excellent for children,if you want you dont have use watershoes,its safety and clean,a lot of bogata parking her? do you can go for a trip

title: Nice but full of dogs
text: On the beach there were free huts with shadows to rest and the beach was clean. But there were a lot of dogs begging for food as soon as you opened a bag of snacks. There were also a lot of boats driving people to the Pigeon island.

title: Beautiful beach
text: Gorgeous beach. Clean and warm water. A very large drag between sandbanks so take care but once past the waves it is a. Delight to float. Very shallow water you can go out a long way.

title: Very clean beach
text: The beach is only 20 minutes away from Trincomalee and it is way cleaner and better for diving. Less restaurants and hotels but very calm and not at all busy.

title: Amazing calm beach
text: Beautiful beach. We spend 1 week at the end of our holiday and it was amazing. clean beach and calm sea. Was perfect for us with our 2 small kids. The beach is not steep and no big waves. So perfect choise for familys

title: Just lovely
text: We’ve spent a month in Sri Lanka and this is by far the best beach we visited. Clean, quiet and great for swimming. There are many places to stay but we highly recommend Bella Nilaveli.

title: Quiet beach
text: Beautiful beach, with calm waters, perfect for families, long walkings and relax. From there you take the boats to Pigeon Island.

title: Beautiful beach, shame about the ribbjsh
text: As mentioned in other comments, this beach is beautiful with crystal waters but apart from the flagged section, it is covered in plastic. We went to watch the sunrise and spent most of our time collecting rubbish but there’s a heck of a lot to clean up.

title: Covered with garbage
text: The beach would be a lovely place but except a few cleaned hotel/restaurant beach stretches, unfortunately it is covered with garbage.

title: Two Thumps up!
text: The beach is one of the uncrowded beaches we’ve ever visited. We are very lucky to spend our fifth anniversary with my wife at the Nilaveli Beach. From the crystal water, the white sand and breathtaking view... Everything is just perfect!

title: Good uncrowded beach
text: Beige sand, ultra clear water (depending on wind/currents), not much trash during high season, place to catch a boat to Pigeon Island for amazing snorkeling (it cost 5,000 in March 2019: 4,000 govt entry fee / 1,000 boatman.

title: Beautiful beach
text: Beach is huge and clean and slopes gently so it is safe for swimming when the waves are not too high. This is apparently March to October, though we swam three days out of four in the warm water in February. Military establishment mid way splits the beach into two halves since you cannot cross.

title: Nice beach
text: Quit beach, some parts are beautiful but unfortunately also pieces where a lot of junk including a lot of plastic is washed up. We stayed at Memo’s Beach Cabana who is cleaning the beach everyday

title: Stay By Hotels
text: The beach is lovely and clean by the hotels but there is quite a bit of rubbish once you walk away from the hotels beach front. We went in January which apparently is the off season for here so very few people on beach. Don’t know why it’s classed as off season as it was 32 degrees for the 3 days we were there and no rain at all.

title: Amazing beach
text: The beach was amazing even though it was abit rough. Still can walk in and the water is not as deep.

title: Beautiful and mostly untouched
text: This seemed to me like the favorite beach for local families. You may not be completely comfortable in a skimpy swimsuit around the many families and children with women going in the water totally covered. Beautiful and natural beach without the resorts and restaurants. Very peaceful!

title: Lovely quiet beach
text: The beach of Nilaveli is unspoiled and wide. There aren’t many hotels and no vendors selling useless stuff on the beach. This is the perfect place where you want to relax a day or two. Be carefull the sand gets hot hot hot.

title: Lovely beach
text: Lovely pretty beach with nice soft sand. Locals and tourists alike use the beach. Quite a few stray dogs but nice ones and cut puppies! Sea is nice for swimming in though there are a few jelly fish to be aware of! There are a few bars on the beach but not many at all. I would definitely recommend getting a hotel that is on the beach or bringing your our parosol if you're not on the beach as there is little/no shade!

title: Magnificent and crystal clear to miles.
text: One of the most beautiful beaches I ever visited. Golden sand and blue waters combination make you jump in to a dip as soon as you see the beach. plenty of eateries and souvenir shops around. Always crowded as this is famous with foreigners and locals alike. must visit place in the eastern Sri Lanka as it is only half an hour drive from Trincomalee.

title: Beautiful beaxh
text: Uncrowded beach - beautiful weather. Quite a choppy sea but fun to swim in. Highly recommended. We stayed at nearby Nilaveli beach hotel

title: Great for a swim
text: We visited the beach before breakfast each morning and had it to ourselves, we also visited around 5pm each afternoon when it was still quite busy but most visitors were in the shallow water close to shore so it was pretty easy to enjoy a bit of swimming further out and body-surf the occasional wave. There seemed to be a bit of voluntary segregation between the foreign visitors in skimpy bathers and the Sri Lankan day-trippers who were mostly fully clothed even while swimming, but there was no unpleasantness around this and some Sri Lankans in lycra bathers (and some who were fully-clothed) were swimming in the same area as the foreign visitors at the northern end of the beach. There was a surf life-saver patrolled area further south beyond the Pigeon Island boat launching area, that section of the beach and further south was very busy.

title: Pretty
text: Nice beach with two good restaurants. Super slow service but amazing food! Super nice water! Only Wierd thing is that the locals swim on one side and tourist on another. Which is a good thing considering they are so loud and obnoxious When we went in August it was not packed at all, very calm and beautiful

title: Fantastic Beach closes 6pm
text: Good beach, reasonably clean, ok for children till 6pm, beach football also good idea. *Accommodation near Nilaveli Beach Trincomalee* *Home Plus++* Reasonably priced, 2 houses Each has 2 bedrooms and a large living room. Halal food Near Masjid Parking facilities ETC Contact: 077744267306 Mr Naseer

title: Gorgeous gorgeous gorgeous
text: White sandy clean beach on shores of Indian Ocean Lifeguards and safe swimming area If youre female think about covering up as not a commercial beach - thongs and topless would not be OK There's a cafe on beach. No showers. Not commercial yet.

title: Great beach
text: The best beach in Sri Lanka. It has a lot of waves but the beach is awesome. Highly recommend. There is not much else to do in the area.

title: Beach at its best
text: The ocean on this part of the East coast of SL is amazing to say the least the beach is gentle and the sand white.

title: too many tourist
text: we enjoyed the beach and its extension although the type of send impeed to have a crystal clear water. Most of the beach is full of boat offering boat rides and you stay to close you spend all the time breathing their engien gas. Some nice bars offer good service at the sun set.

title: Stunning
text: A stunningly beautiful beach. Absolutely nothing on it. Pleased to see litter bins. There are a few hotels dotted along the beach, one would assume you could buy a drink or meal here. It’s possible to get boats to Pigeon Island from the beach.

title: Lovely tree lined beach
text: We stayed at Oceanfront condos and enjoyed the beautiful Nilaveli beach. The water was lovely although there were a few jelly fish, but they did not seem to sting and it didn't stop us enjoying the beach.

title: A very Nice beach
text: We visited this lovely Beach in july 2018. There are Hardy any people there and it is wonderfull. It is easy to get a boat to Pigion Island if you like that og to go on a dolphine/whale watch in the early morning. The waves Can be Big, but it is still a Nice place for kids too. The water is clear and clean.

title: beach
text: Nice wide beach. Usually bigger waves very good for fun and jumping. With view at the Pigeon Island. Possible boat taxi to the Pigeon Island.

title: Decent beach. Not very busy.
text: Took a walk along this beach after diving Nilaveli. Beach was pretty empty. I was looking for somewhere to eat. Not many options.

title: Greatbeach
text: Clean beach, great to swim, relax and enjoy the sun. I would recommend for anyone passing by the east of Sri Lanka.

title: Beautiful beach
text: Beautiful clean beach.This beach is really perfect Not too many people's hear. Evening is the best time to get a sunbath hear.

title: Long beach
text: Have only some old resort near bech. Only resort restaurant to buy soft drinks. If you like to be alone mayby beach is good for your.

title: Nice beach, shame about the rubbish
text: The beach here is quite good, but unfortunately there is a lot of plastic rubbish that washes up. Swimming is still good, and the sunrise over the ocean was good too. Try to pick up some rubbish while you walk the beach, every little bit helps. Most of the dogs on the beach are friendly, you may see the occasional herd of cattle too

title: Unbelievable!
text: Absolutely brilliant beach. So quiet and tranquil. The beach is perfect to swim. Gentle waters with just the right waves. Not crowded. Some parts you can have it all to yourself. There are even fishes jumping ard the waves. That could delight or disturb you : ) In all my travels, i miss Nilaveli. I usualy never miss any beach location. Somehow i miss Nilaveli as i left. We prob made a connection. There is smth abt this place. Very romantic and blissfull. No touts, blaring beach pubs or restos etc. Just you, the beach and the waves!

title: Amazing beach
text: Untouched. White sandy beaches. Smooth. No rubbish. Just you and nature. Also cows. Fisherman and a few stray dogs grace the beach. Not ruined at all. No one bothers you and no shops to ruin what nature intended. Sea is amazing. Clear blue. Warm and wonderful

title: A Place Where You Need To Look Past What Lies On Top To See The Beauty
text: For what lies on top of the beach, this gorgeous white sand beach, an uncrowded beach where the swimming is safe and the water is clear. What washes up is masses and masses of plastic pollution. . Bless the staff at the various properties dotted along the beach that now seem responsible for cleaning this up and disposing of it.

title: Brilliant!
text: Me and my grandma walk this beach everyday and it’s a very relaxing place. There is life guard and two flags to swim in between for safety reasons which is brilliant. The lifeguards pick up the rubbish everyday at a walkable distance then get ready to support the locals and tourists that want to enjoy a swim. The sea is a warm temperature and everybody is full of joy here. Definitely would recommend

title: Beautiful, quiet beach
text: Really nice beach with clear, blue water that's great for swimming. Very quiet though the season was just starting when I visited. Just a few dive shops and accommodation options on the beach, with some restaurants on the side streets. The marine runs many boats out to Pigeon Island or they can be arranged through hotels or dive shops.

title: Off the beaten track beach in Sri Lanka
text: If you made it to Sri Lanka it's worth considering coming here for 4-5 days beach time rather than the more advanced south... it's quite developed but do not expect much. Nethertheless you can find all a happy tourist needs: local excellent quality seafood, reasonably priced hotels (never pay > $50 per double room here, anything above is a tourist trap) and amazing sunrises on the beach + scuba diving, snorkeling, fishing or dolphins watching trips... The only dissapointing thing was trash on the beach and lots of stray dogs. Would have been an amazing place without these 2!

title: Hurry
text: The last of the virgin white sand beaches. Pristine and made for indulging yourself with doing nothing. Tourists are yet to land here in hordes. Enjoy it now, another two years it will be like another commercial beach.

title: Beautiful Nice beach
text: It is a nice beach to relax & sun bathe. But now it is getting dirty because of the misbehaviour of humans. Specually local people. They need not to protect this for future generation. I can not say about after few years what will happen if it is going on same way.

title: Very dirty
text: This beach looks like a giant trashbin off season... It is cleaned only in front of the biggest hotels. This might be different in high season though, no idea.

title: Nice beach with clean water
text: We visited Nilaveli beach off season so there were only few people and we could enjoy the beach. Water was clean, but the beach was full of litter - bottles, cans etc. - this was typical for all beaches which we visited. It is nothing exeptional at Sri Lanka.

title: Beautiful water but beach itself has littering
text: We went there during off season and were surprised to see so many people enjoying the lovely water. There were few life guards who were quite strict about how far people were allowed to swim. Was really good to see how they made sure everyone was safe. As for the beach itself, like most other beaches in SriLanka there is too much littering. Bottles, cans, plastic etc thrown everywhere. Takes away from the beauty of this fantastic beach.

title: Clean beach
text: This is a worth wile going to beach. The beach was clean and nice. There were enough parking places and some local shops. Only issue is changing rooms and toilet facility both of which don't exist.

title: Beautiful beach, but not clean everywhere
text: Nilaveli is a very beautiful beach to walk along. We took a long walk when we stayed at Nilaveli Beach Resort toward the Nilaveli Beach Hotel. In between these two hotels, there were 3-4 little guest houses too. The beachfront belonging to these two hotels and the guesthouses was very clean. These beach areas were marked by a red flag. In between however, there was a lot of garbage on the beach. It looked like some people dumped their big black-plastic-bags-full of garbage on the beach. It was unfortunate that they could not find an alternative to this. In front of our hotel, the beach was super clean. We even saw some beach patrol by armed military closer to the Nilaveli Beach Hotel. Another interesting factor was seeing a lot of cows on the beach. In the evening they went back to their abode (wherever that might be) in small groups.

title: Peacefull surrounding and best waves for bodyboarder
text: If you want to visit a peaceful and friendly locaton with great beach, visit That's why CafÃ© and Beach Bar in Nilaveli Beach! We will be back!

title: Not the best beach for a swim!
text: We were staying at the Pigeon Island Resort and there are very limited opportunities to swim on the beach due to rocks and waves.

title: Beautiful beach of golden sands.
text: This beach is really perfect, with clean golden sand, backed by palmtrees and screwpines. My hotel was only 2mins away, so I was very pleased to see there was a lifeguard area just 100m down the beach. As it was the monsoon season, there were very few visitors, except at weekends when crowds of Sri Lankans arrived in buses to spend the day, bathing and partying, which was a lot of fun as everyone was so friendly. There's a little lane of shops and cafes behind the beach where everyone gathered to buy toys, sweets and street food, though it was closed during the week due to lack of visitors. Most people stay in the lifeguard area, but I enjoy beach walks, so several times I walked a few kilometres southwards, and had it all to myself. During the monsoon season the sea can be very rough, so it's almost impossible to swim as the current is so dangerous. Most of the local visitors just stood in the water, in all their clothes! I expect the beach would be totally different in the tourist season, probably with sunbeds etc., but I liked it as it was, wild and wonderful!

title: Beautiful beach
text: Nilaveli beach is a beautiful, clean and vast beach overlooking Pigeon Island. Excellent safe swimming here, with wide sandy beach, ideal for families with children. Lots of trips to Pigeon Island.

title: Beautiful white sandy beach
text: Shallow water, warm and safe to a considerable distance. Quiet and peaceful beach. We enjoyed the day on the beach.

title: Beautiful, clean beach
text: We stayed at Nilaveli Beach for the whole afternoon, playing in the water and the calm waves. Beautiful place just to relax and enjoy a swim. The beach is clean and very long, so there were no crowds of people.

title: Lovely quiet clean beach
text: Enjoyed our 5 nights at this lovely beach. Very peaceful. Good small surf for swimming. Not dangerous. Sand had a little rubbish washed up above high tide mark, but really not much. A highlight is watching the village fishermen haul their net onto the beach. Beautiful fine golden sand. Can recommend Nagenahira Beach Villas for accommodation.

title: Fantastic Beach
text: North of Trincomalee the beach at Nilaveli has to be one of the best in the whole of Sri Lanka with ocean normally calmer and warmer than the west coast of the island. Many activities for water and nature lovers. There are several upmarket hotels

title: Best place for family
text: Golden sand Very clean beach Not much crowded during weekdays No big waves Safe for Children Life guard available till 6

title: Beautiful long stretch of sand
text: We had read some reviews that implied this beach was dirty. We were glad to find this was untrue! While we were here the beach had lots of people in the water near the life guard point but the rest of the beach was almost empty. We spent hours splashing around in the waves. You can see lots of cows on the beach if you make it down early enough! This is a relaxed beach which is not filled with tourists or touts. It was great for us!

title: Beautiful deserted beach
text: Stunning beach with soft white Sam and clear blue sea. Beach has nobody on apart from a few tourists and local fishermen

title: Beautiful beach
text: This is also a very long stretch of beach.It being February this is not the season to be here , so maybe thats the reason I did not see any schools for diving open at the beach , same for the small restaurants. However the beach does have many resorts opening to it. A nice relaxing time you can have the beach.

title: Beautiful beach
text: You can walk for hours (apart from the military park which stops you getting down to Tissa) which is a bit of a shame.

title: Great, deserted beach
text: This is a gorgeous, long, normally empty beach perfect for those wanting to get away from it all. The sea is clean, very warm and there are usually waves, which are fun for kids. You might come across the occasional cow, a friendly dog or two and perhaps some lines of fishermen hauling in their nets. Nothing else. Wonderful place.

title: Picturesque beach
text: A nice, laid back beach - seemed to be safe to swim with some surf suitable of for body surfing. On an international scale it is a nice beach and very quiet (i.e. no crowds), but it is not as good as most Australian beaches (I'm Australian).

title: Beautiful beach
text: I love this beach, it's beautiful, clean and not a lot of tourists, so it's quite! The sand is nice and the waves are cool! If you want to relax, this is the right beach for you!!

title: Beautiful and quiet beach
text: Golden sand, wonderful blue Indian Ocean, calm shallow water with small waves, palm trees, boats. Hardly anyone around, very quiet, one of the last crowd free beaches in Sri Lanka Ã1⁄4 though I guess not for long as new and large hotels now being built. Apart from enjoying the sunshine, the sea and the view there is not much else to do, but this was exactly what I was looking for. There are funny dog families on the beach who like to spend their time with human company but they are not hungry beggars at all. They have a unique society and it is fun to observe. Once in a while cows passing by, trying to chew everything they find, including shoes, but easy to scare them away :) I am sure for those who like the active kind of holiday these beaches are not the best but for those who seek for tranquillity and the tropic beaches at the same time this is a very good choice.

title: Crowd Free Beach
text: While this beach is anything but pristine, what with roving cattle and. . . frankly more garbage than usual, there are few people. Also, there are traditional net fisherman around who are happy enough enlisting you for some shore-pulling. The sea drops off more than I would have expected so walking in the surf isn't really possible.

title: Seeing is believing
text: Went on a day trip to this fabulous beach. Miles and miles of white silky sand . Sea itself is relatively calm and is sandy if you fancy a dip.

title: One of the best in SL during hte season
text: Stunning color of the water with sandy beach makes it on of the best in SL. Ability to snorkel in pigeon island is a plus.

title: Beautiful Beach!
text: Absolutely beautiful beach - you can walk for ages it seems on the silken sand. When we were there, the water was nice and calm and you could walk, undisturbed ( face it, locals selling wares are sometimes a problem on Sri Lankan beaches). I hear during the "season" the water is blue and stunning - when we went the season was off and the weather was a tad gray and drab, but STILL the beach was beautiful

title: One of the most beautiful beach in the country
text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the country, and a very calm beach during the season with very limited waves. Ideal for beach lovers and also for snorkeling because of the very rich sea life.

title: Great beach
text: Beautiful beach, even off-season. Maybe some rubbish in some places but you can walk some distance and its fine

title: Tranquil and Clean
text: Serene and clean beaches, A lot of scuba fiving happening her during the the month of may to october.

title: A nice beach but little haunted
text: The beach is neat and clean and the water isn't too muddy as well. But there isn't much of the crowd in the beach. Good in one sense but becomes scary at times.

title: Beautiful beach
text: A nice crowded local beach. The waves were high but the locals said usually here pretty calm and clean water. Don't plan your trip on the weekends because of the local crowed. Worth a try.

title: What a stunning piece of coastline!
text: The water is so clean and blue, the sand is so soft and everything around is so quiet and peaceful. What a gorgeous beach and somewhere the locals should be proud of...

title: Good swimming beach
text: Clean and not many people (or at least in September). 2 minutes to the famous pigeon island. Recommended.

title: nice beach
text: very nice marble beach, we loved swimming there and enjoying sun bathing, very quiet you can sleep or read a book in peace. lots of monkeys

title: Lovely beach and very friendly atmosphere
text: Safe to swim in (we travelled in August and almost everywhere else we stayed on Sri Lanka was unsafe for swimming).

title: Clean powdery beach
text: I was staying nearby at the Nilaveli beach hotel so the beach was directly in front of the hotel. It was a clean stretch of powdery white sand that wasn't too long but you could walk for quite a distance to get away from the local crowds. There are two large beach resorts there and a few dive centers. The waters look to be pretty clean and there were always some people playing in the waters so the current can't be too strong in the area.

title: Sexual harrassment as female travellers
text: Me and my friend visited this beach today after reading all the lovely reviews but have never felt more uncomfortable in an area. We were constantly harassed by men which made up the majority of the people on the beach and there was no way I would have got into my bikini or swimming costume. All the ladies were in full clothes in the sea. We got straight back into a tuktuk back to Uppeveli beach. If you want to relax in peace as a couple of female friends would not recommend this place

title: Beautiful beach
text: Absolutely gorgeous beach with clear shallow water. Coral sand and pretty view of Pigeon island. Not much in the way of places to eat or drink - that's why it is unspoiled. Don't wander too far up the beach though as you'll be turned back by the Sri Lankan Navy guard - active base at top tip of beach.

title: Really nice beach
text: Very beautiful beach in eastern Sri Lanka. One of the beaches that tourists should visit along with Marble Beach and Passikudha

title: White sandy beach
text: Peaceful beach with white sand and crystal clear and warm waters. Clean beach regularly patrolled by the coast guards. Ideal for surfing and swimming.

title: Crystel Beach
text: the sea is so Crystal and so transparent clear water, mostly packed with locals. wave less beach, good for swimming, better to carry on your own food and mats.

title: One of my favorite beach of all time
text: The water is warm and no big waves. While you are swimming you can also see some fish are swimming near by. Such a beautiful and quiet beach. I love it ??

title: Big beach with high waves
text: Visited in Feb and enjoyed the cooler and breezy beach. Great for beach walks but could be cool at this time of year for some. As a base to visit Trinco it is ideal but you need a car and driver.

title: feel the sand
text: it is a large sand beach, ideal to walk barefoot for hours. its clean, calm, relaxing, everything u need for a perfect beach day!!

title: Its even better than South Beach Miami as its serene and peaceful
text: Nilaveli Beach is very clean, clear and safe to swim. We took a short boat trip to see the corals in Pigeon Island.

title: Blue ocean and sandy beaches.
text: A must see in Trinco. Couple of kilometres away from trincomalee town, towards the kuchchiweli road, you would find this blue heaven. Good spot if you love to have a bath in the sea, make sure there is no red flag.

title: Nice quiet beach
text: We spent three nights at a hotel that had access to this beach. The beach was the best part of the stay. It is nice and quite, there weren't a lot of people. Perfect place to relax and enjoy life.

title: Great beach, no pollution and save to swim.
text: Nilaveli Beach is a really nice long white sand beach. There are a lot of hotels in Nilaveli and they keep the beach nice and clean. This beach is ideal for swimming, even with little kids (still keep them in your sight). Just take a long walk and see local fisherman trying to catch fish. Or sit down, relax and enjoy a cocktail. There are some nice spots where you can sit, drink and eat (owned by the hotels). Looking at the sea you will notice a small island, this is the famous Pigeon Island (National Park). You can go by boat to this island and do some great snorkelling. Nilaveli beach is for sure one of the best beaches to swim in Sri Lanka!

title: Nice Beach
text: The beach is excellent. Green water now very high waves (in Aug). They are clean as well. Can see fisherman activity in the morning.

title: Wide beach
text: The Nilavelli beach is about 5km long beach, It is wide like in Thailand... great place for chill out near the ocean.

title: Relax
text: A quiet place in september. The most of the Hotels and Homestays are nearly empty because of low season and all these nice white sand beaches are yours. You only need to share the view with some cows wich is pretty fun.

title: Beautiful beach but not much around it
text: Beautiful beach. Not much shade or hotels on the beach. Water very clear and clean lovely for swimming. This is a beach you might not see one other person on the beach the same time as you which we loved.

title: Clean water and beach
text: Coming form a landlocked country, visiting a beach whenever we travel is a big deal for us. But most of the time, we are dispppointed when we see unclean beaches with stuff discarded by beach goers. Nilaveli was different. The beach was suprisingly clean. I could see why the beach was called Nilaveli - i loved the blue sand and the clean water. Though I didn't venture out of swim, I stood in the water for almost an hour enjoying the feel of clean water against the sand. The beach is relatively less crowded on a weekday and filled with locals. I can spend an entire day here, enjoying the sand and the water.

title: Perfect holiday beach
text: We enjoyed a perfect 8 days relaxing on the beach here. Low currents this time of year so easy swimming. Nileveli up the coast is the most beautiful and quieter. Watch out for the jellyfish there were loads when we 1st arrived and saw a few people who had been stung. They aren't dangerous but looks uncomfortable.

title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful, no hawkers just sea and sand. Only hotel bars though this may change in the coming years.

title: wBeUtiful beach spoilt by tourists
text: Go here for sunbaking, Western food and crowds. Book ahead as whole place really does get booked out, at least in August. Hard to get food early in morning. Take your own alcohol if you dont always want to drink in bar.

title: Quiet, clean, perfect!
text: Squeekly clean sand, palm-fringed beach. Small shore break for body surfing. Get up early for a walk along the beach and you'll find hard-working locals pulling in their large fishing net. Give them a hand. They'll greatly appreciate the help.

title: Like a Swimming Pool
text: Wonderful Day Nilaveli Beach Beautiful Beach in Srilanka Snorkling, Sharks, Turtle Lovely Day i had in Nilaveli I found Fairly Decent Accommodation as Well

title: Trashy beach
text: Biggest disappointment on Sri Lanka. Lots of trash and cow pats everywhere. Only next to the hotels is a little bit better. Very high prices for everything. Uppuveli is better but also nothing special.

title: Beautiful beach
text: Miles if deserted beach. Beautiful location. Only drawback is that it is very isolated from any amenities apart from the hotels

title: nice and quit beach
text: Nice and quit beach, perfect place to swim, play volleyball, or juts chill and read a book, have fun

title: Beautiful but rough
text: This is a beautiful beach but there are big(ish) waves so not ideal for little children. We stayed on a clean patch of beach which our hotel cleaned themselves but other areas are littered with rubbish which is sad to see. Nevertheless, we stayed for 6 days and thoroughly relaxed. It is never over crowded and felt like a private beach.

title: Nice beach but..
text: A very nice beach with clean waters. The only problem is that the wandering cows fill the place with excrements and makes it difficult to take a walk

title: Too much rubbish
text: We were quite disappointed with our visit to Nilaveli beach. There is rubbish scattered all over the sand and in the water. It's disgusting! Also, there is barely any shade on the beach so you are stuck underneath the blazing hot sun the entire time. If you want a nicer beach, try Marble beach. The lack of restaurants/Cafes on the beach was also very disappointing.

title: Very nice but damn expensive
text: The beach is a long strap sand with some trees. The water is nice without being exceptional. It is not as clear as some Thai beaches. There are very beautiful hotels on and around the beach. I was there during the high season (August) and I have been surprised by the price. Impossible to find any room for less than 80 US$! There are beautiful hotels, like the Nilaveli beach Hotel, where is wonderful to spend the day. Bit at this season it was full booked and I guess a room would cost more than 200 US$. So if you watch your budget, don't go there during high season!

title: Pristine calm waters and a long clean sandy beach
text: Not much more to say, easy to see why this place is getting a reputation when it is in season. Very relaxing to spend a few days here.

title: Nature and quiet place. On Aug.
text: We was here on Aug. It's nature and really quiet beach. Only little ppl are there, and more local ppl came. Only one restaurant(local restaurant, not expensive) is there. 3-4 boat shop for going to the Pigeon island, and the couple of Diving shops there. We were there by Tuktuk and costed 600rs from 14km far from beach.

title: Lovely beach
text: Beautiful beach with calm water. Very peaceful place to just sit and relax. Lots of water sports available.

title: Amazing!
text: Me and my girl friend were the only people on this beautifull beach. So absolutly go if you are near by! I bet after 10 years it will be full of hotels and people so go before it is too late!

title: Nice beach
text: Nice beach but a shame their is not a more local offering, just one bar and restaurant. Nice to see lots of families enjoying it. Would loved to have seen local people making the most of it...but things are changing and fingers crossed this will happen.

title: Best beach in Sri Lanka
text: Beautiful and quiet would highly recommend, with the 'right' type of responsible tourism hope it stays this way. :)

title: True Paradise
text: One of the best beaches in the country. Can get busy on the weekends with family but for a traveler, it's a great way to experience this part of the country.

title: Incredible beach
text: Long sandy beach with incredible emerald blue sea. The sea was almost bath temperature and extremely calm when we were there, although a slight undertow

title: A few days on the Nilaveli Beach
text: The Nilaveli Beach is quite nice with warm and clean water and white sand. In front of the hotels/resorts it is quite clean but it gets dirty anywhere else. Most places have beach facilities like chairs, shades, bar/restaurant, but we could not find a nice place to hang around. Very quiet area, not really a party place.

title: amazing place to see
text: amazing view. if you see some fisherman pulling a long net called "maa dela", make sure to go join to pull... wonderful experience

title: Marvellous nature :)
text: remote & relaxing area in Sri Lanka, quiet surroundings, only nature around, few tourists in the whole Nilaveli, almost not seen. Road from Colombo airport may be not very convenient, 6-8 hours by car, so take the driver or just stay somewhere in the middle for a night. Trincomalee region is noth east coast, and that is far place to visit the whole country staying only there. I advise that to stay for relax after hiking or after visiting the south. However one day trips to Sigiriya, Dambulla or Wilpattu national park are possible if you hire the car or the driver with the car. That costs, but it is worth it, if you have a limited amount of days in Sri Lanka. if you are looking for the tourist facilities, a lot of shops and bars that is not the place for you. That is for the nature lovers and those you prefer to meet the real local culture and try origin local food.

title: Goes On and On forever
text: lovely beach - we caught it at the tail-end of a monsoon so there was quite a bit of stuff washed ashore - for some reason loads of shoes and sandals - odd.

title: Touristic
text: Average beach where all the tourists come because here are the only bars and restaurants in Trinco. Mostly clean but not so wide.

title: Deep is so far away
text: It's a beautiful place that you want to visit if you love the beach and sunshine. Normally, season starts in July and I went their when the season just started so I did not run into many tourists. During mid season time, I was told it could be crowded. If you go to the beach around 5.30, 6.00 a.m in the morning, you could see the sun rise.

title: Perfect
text: Loved loved loved the beach. It was super quiet, the water was amazing no currents .. and extremely clean. Perfect beach for a laid back day!

title: nilaveli Guesthouse!
text: i stay here in a really friendly and cosy guesthouse ist called NILAVELI GUEST home! the owner are so wonderfull and friendly! i can recommend this please.. when you Need a break from travel and a silence day go there.. the beach is awesome!!

title: Beautifull and clean beach
text: Beach was so beautiful, but december is not good for beach. Sea really rough. Water was not clean in December.

title: Beautiful beach much nicer then upaweli beach
text: I went there today by bicycle from Upawli where I am staying. The beach is lovely and I was the only person there for most of the afternoon. The whole place is shut down and it all looks like a ghost town. I wanted to stay there but booking com stated that the cheapest room is 1500 rupees. If you asked you will get a room for 1500 rupees but I decided to stay in upawli as I would be lonley there. The beach is great though and I enjoyed the body surfing there.

title: Lovely beech, great views
text: We went out of season and so the water was choppy but I still went in and absolutely loved it. There were lifeguards on duty and they showed us where to swim. Funnily enough there is also a life saving division in the police, so there were a fair few uniformed people looking out for tourists and locals on the beech. As its a large beach, there is plenty of space for everyone. Had a great time here. Will definitely go again in season April time.

title: Solitude and bliss
text: Clean and long beach. Comfortable entrance, very few people if you move away from the village. Beautiful views, there are several places where you can eat, but the infrastructure is poorly developed. Great place if you want to stay alone with him.
