title: Safari with Lahiru
text: Depends on tons of positive reviews on TripAdvisor, I booked the safari with Lahiru(two for 18000LKR). Because of his knowledge of elephants, we saw two male elephants “fighting”. It is definitely unforgettable experience in Sri Lanka. Find Lahiru by whatsapp +94762727699.

title: Must go here if you love elephants
text: Really great to see elephants thriving in a natural 76,000 protected National Park habitat. Book through a wide range of tour companies..no need for a park guide as the tour guides are very good. You can get very close to the elephants...also great place for bird spotters as well as water and wild Buffalo, Monitor Lizards, Monkeys, Jackals and Leopards (if you are very lucky). Very safe and well organised. Good three hour drive from Galle and probably same from Colombo so long day ..leave 4 hours for park safari.

title: Mansala Safari House made this a perfect experience
text: We loved our Udawalawe National Park safari experience, from arriving at dusk and seeing the elephants waiting for bananas along the fence line, to the hospitability and great food at Mansala Safari House and, of course, our animal packed private sunrise safari tour – it was a magical 24 hours and one of the highlights of the trip! We booked only a few days before and were able to arrange a private safari through Tiron from Mansala Safari House, all through whatsapp and for a very reasonable price. On the day we were greeted by a lovely driver who spoke great English. There was no need to get a guide as he had a keen eye and was very good at spotting animals. He also provided us with Binoculars! When we entered the park entrance, there were probably 50 or so other jeeps but once we were let in we found that we were mostly alone during our 4 hour safari. If you are worried you will be in a line of jeeps and won’t see any animals – we totally recommend you book with Tiron and stay at the Mansala Safari house.

title: Trip to see elephants in the wild
text: We stayed in the National park and arrived early morning to the reserve and were lucky enough to witness so many elephants their young wondering wild. The bird life was vast with peacocks buzzards and many more living unhindered. The vehicle we travelled in was driven by a local tour guild who pointed out the animals and told us about the protective laws now in place for the protection of the wildlife. Well worth doing but book locally as it’s much cheaper than using a travel agent.

title: Lovely Park
text: Me and my friends decided to take a safari tour with Lahiru Prasad (+94762726799) after reading so many good reviews on here. He arranged a transfer from Ella into the park, it was very nice weather and he provide us with some water and biscuits. We also managed to see crocodiles, buffalos, eagles, and all sorts of fauna. Amazing experience ??

title: Fantastic trip, definitely worth a visit!
text: We had a fantastic morning at the Udawalawe National Park. It was amazing to see so many wild animals out in the open plains—birds, peacocks, elephants, water buffaloes, monkeys, chameleon. Our trip to the park was made possible with Lahiru. He organised a pickup from Mirissa and dropped us off at Ella in a clean and comfortable ride. Everything was seamless and smooth. He is also really knowledgeable about the park, the animals, and has a good eye for spotting them. The driver who came along was also very skilled and friendly. Lahiru also got us breakfast and provided cold drinks. We are really pleased and highly recommend him: +94762726799 (WhatsApp)

title: An amazing experience!!!
text: Due to our visit in Sri Lanka this safari was on our list so we couldn't wait to feel the amazing experience being in nature, in the heart of a jungle where wild life exists and live. After having spend around 2 hours and a half driving from Hikkaduwa and made a short stop to Elephant transit home to see the orphan elephants we took the special jeep for the safari. The day was perfect for such an activity warm but not hot and partly cloudy. Our driver was very good and was able to found all the hidden animals around the area, also very well educated regarding the animals and their bahviour. We had so great time as we met a lot elephants alone or families, bulls, snake, peacocks, many birds and some crocodile and all in very close distance, like being part of this place. A great experience that we strongly recommend to all tourists that is going to visit Sri Lanka. Also is not a so expensive tour. We had this tour with Norlanka Tours which are very good and very well organised company.

title: Afternoon well spent in nature with Lahiru
text: We enjoyed our afternoon jeep Safari with Lahiru on the 17th in some fabulous weather. The safari jeep had six seats which we had all for ourselves - a group of 2 adults and 2 children. Lahiru had some water and snacks for us and he took us on off-beaten paths with no other jeeps around. Out in the park we saw eagles, bee-eaters, jackals, turtles, a croc, storks, pelicans, spotted deer, a hornbill, a magnificent brown fish owl, monitor lizards, kingfishers, cormorants, the ubiquitous peacocks and at least five herds of elephants spread across different locations totalling around fifty in all, some with one-month old babies. That I guess was pretty much everything one could spot in the park. Lahiru made us spend about twenty minutes close to a herd with baby elephants. It was exhilarating to see these mighty beasts in their eye, so close up. Lahiru’s photography skills were excellent too! The drive back past the Udawalawe reservoir in fading light was also awesome. I would say, this was well worth the 150$ for 4-hours of absolute bliss - we must have covered at least 40kms in all. We had chosen Lahiru based on the glowing TA reviews and boy, he did not disappoint. Contacting him at +94 762726799 was a breeze. One piece of advice- those with sensitive airways could do well with some masks because of the trailing dust from a jeep ahead of you on those dry jungle tracks.

title: The best Jeep safari!
text: This is the second Jeep safari for us in Sri Lanka as we did not see any elephants on our first in Gal Oya National Park. In Udawalawe we saw over 20 elephants in different locations! There was one herd of approx 12 in a group together close to the road. We also saw a lot of other animals on the trip but the elephants were definitely the highlight! There are many jeeps waiting to take tours right across the road from the park. Our Jeep was comfortable and the driver/guide was great. It was 5000 rp each for approx 2 hours.

title: Very nice safari
text: Very nice safari this morning with our driver Shameera. He was able to spot many animals for us with his "eagle eye". He drived sliwly so we can have time to observe the animals quietly. We saw elephants, foxes, crocodiles, buffalos, iguana, cameleon and many birds !!! Even if many jeeps are present, the park is big and we were alone most of the time or just followed by one jeep. You can contact him at +94 76 481 0350

title: If you like animals, you'll be bothered by this experience
text: This park really needs to change the way they do safaris and limit the amount of vehicles in the park. The problem is that they allow hotels to arrange safaris--which all compete with each, this results in an abundance of vehicles in the park with only 1-2 people. So when you see a family of elephants, too many vehicles swarm around them, prohibiting the animals from moving in the direction they want, and causing them to be stressed. Furthermore, with so many vehicles in one area, the exhaust smell is strong and the engines are loud---also not good for the elephants. The park also needs to be stricter with the drivers by reminding them to keep distance and respect the animals. We all found this experience to be very troubling. I highly suggest when you book your safari, try booking through the park itself, and ask to be put with others in vehicles to limit them in the park. These animals need to be respected in their living space.

title: Wonderful tour
text: We decided to take an afternoon tour with Lahiru and we didn't regret it. Immediately we saw a huge mating elephant really up close, and many others throughout the tour, including some baby ones. Lahiru was great at spotting other animals, such as crocodiles, deers and so on. While we saw a few tour guides driving fast and scaring off birds and and elephant, Lahiru kept a really respective distance, and found ways to come close enough without disturbing them, which I really appreciated.

title: If you love elephants this is the park for you...
text: I don't think I have been so close to so many elephants on a safari, it was really special to see them thriving in their own habitat and obviously very used to being observed by visitors as they didn't take any notice of people in safari jeeps... There was lots of other wildlife to see in the park but it was the elephants that make this such a special place...

title: Sri Lankan Elephants
text: Amazing wildlife safari in udawalawe. So many elephants.safari guide is very good, and knowledgeable. Nice day in Sri Lanka.

title: Lots of elephants
text: We were very lucky to have some close encounters with the elephants and to see jackals, crocodiles and water buffalo and then so many different birds that I can’t list them all but bee eaters, peacocks, bush fowl, hornbills, kingfishers and painted stork were all to be found. Great three hour game drive.

title: Wonderful
text: We had a fantastic half-day safari where we spotted elephants, buffalo, deer, crocodiles, and a gazillion peacocks and other cool birds. We booked through our hotel and had an excellent guide who was very knowledgeable and could spot a green parrot in a tree from 20 metres! From reading other reviews it seems like you get what you pay for. When we were queuing we were worried about all the other vehicles around us but when we got into the park everyone went their separate ways. Maybe we were lucky, however - corona virus and the time of year meaning fewer tourists than usual. Also, I imagine some of the roads we drove down would be impassable in the wet season, forcing all the jeeps onto a few larger roads. All in all, I loved it and got the chance to see elephants in the wild.

title: Perfect!
text: Wow! That was a super safari! Our guide Lahiru took us on time on the hotel and had even breakfast and drinks for us. We have seen so many animals and u.a. Mungos, various great bird species, elephants, crocodiles ... just the elephants have come close to it, but without hunting or standing them. An elephant herd of about 5-6 animals were exactly before our car and it was even a month of old baby. A very special moment. Lahiru speaks english very well and can even anneavant animals in German. Thank you again !!! Contact LAHIRU +94 76 272 6799

title: Excellent morning safari

title: Aeesome day and lots of elephants and other animals

title: Ultimate tour with lahira and his powerful 4 X 4. The best tour available!
text: We just returned from a tour of the park with lahira prasad. I was hesitant at first to keep my booking with him as his price was more than the others and I wasn't sure it would be worth it but due to all the good reviews on here we decided to spend the extra £20 (figured if you're coming all this way £20 is nothing to get a good experience!) title: Lahiru Private Guide Tour
text: My family and I had a great private guided tour of Udawalawe National Park with Lahiru. They both had a great time in the jeep and we managed to see lots of the wildlife in the park as well as getting up close to many of the elephants. Would highly recommend booking Lahiru for a private tour, he comes to collect from your hotel and was an easy process to enter the park and tour around. Lahiru can be contacted via Whats App on +94 76 272 6799

title: More like harassing elephants
text: This was more like harassing elephants than spotting them in an eco friendly way. Imagine at least 20 vehicles converging on a herd of elephants & another 20 on their way. It was like a circus. The Jeep I went with could have taken another couple but instead they put them in a Jeep of their own & there were plenty of others with sole occupants. This highlighted that it was a more a money making initiative for each driver than for the mental well being of the elephants. I have more vehicles in my photos than elephants. It is not something I will ever do again EVER. The poor elephants having to put up with all that ‘in your face’ stuff, with some being quite distressed due to a constant stream of vehicles blocking their paths. It left me feeling appalled that I even did it. It was wrong on a number of fronts. Firstly their is the mental health of the poor elephants to consider, then of course you have all those vehicles (car pooling is not considered), ripping up the environment, fuel consumption & exhaust contributing to the greenhouse gas emissions, should I go on. So it definitely was not environmentally friendly in so many ways. If you are considering going then consider the above.

title: Udawalawe National Park safari with fantastic guide Lahiru

title: the best place to watch wild elephants in Sri Lanka

title: One day trip with 4x4 - Lahiru
text: We had a brilliant safari this morning with Lahiru at Udawalawe National Park. We were picked up from our hotel in Ella at 4.30 by Lahiru’s driver and taken to Udawalawe. From there we jumped in the Land Rover and started the safari. Within a few minutes we saw some elephants not too far from the side of the road, then within another few minutes we saw a single male elephant right next to the road. We couldn’t believe it! Lahiru was keen to make sure we saw as much as we could and had plenty of time to get photographs. He pointed out everything he saw including Chameleons hiding on branches. His driver turned the engine off when we got near any animals so we could take our time to photograph them or just stare in amazement. Apart from on the main toad we only saw other safari vehicles twice. The vehicle we went in was a Land Rover which meant we could go off the main roads people usually take and went down to the lake, lots of the other vehicles can’t do this because of the wet ground. Towards the end of our safari we came across some more Elephants, we stopped briefly and headed past them to a lake to see the crocodiles before the sun got too hot. Then we went back to where the elephants were and just patiently sat while they got nearer to us, and we realised they had a baby with them. It was the most amazing thing, just being able to sit and watch them and being so close to them. We would highly recommend Lahiru to anyone thinking about doing a safari. Other animals we saw include water buffaloes, land monitors, deer, Jackels, lots of birds including king fishers, crested eagle and loads of peacocks. After our safari the driver took us onwards to Mirissa. Doing a day trip was perfect and it was brilliant that we were picked up and dropped off so we didn’t need to worry about transport. If you’ve not got much time in Sri Lanka don’t miss this day trip! Just drop him a WhatsApp message: +94 76 272 6799. Thanks again - Adam & Amber

title: Great Experience
text: We visited the park on an evening safari beginning at 2pm and finishing at 5pm. I highly recommend making sure you are there as late (or as early) as possible as a number of animals came out towards the end of the tour as it cooled down. Tour was great and the driver was very experienced and was able to show us a number of different animals long before we could see anything (wild cat, lizards, monkeys, birds, ‘bambi’ and as expected plenty of elephants). It was definitely worth the trip. Only four stars though because these tours have a long way to go to meet the price they charge. All the vehicles follow each other in the park and you almost go up the same route you came down, and only experience a small part of the park. If they were to replicate the safari’s in Africa I have been lucky enough to experience they would benefit from two way radio’s in the car (so they can communicate when they see something), a guide to provide info on the history and about the animals and sealed roads to cover larger areas (where is the money going from all these tours??). This would allow them to cover more of the park and enhance the experience for the consumer.

title: Best Safari and guided by Lahiru
text: We received excellent service from Lahiru. He is a local guide and privately organises everything himself. It started with a no hassle pick up (At 6.30am - most pick up at 5.00am but then get stuck in a que for up to an hour). We were in very quickly and Lahiru was very quick to spot any movement. We saw a large amount of birds and lizards as well as many elephant. Our highlight was definitely the up close Elephants which he tried very hard to find for us. Overall, we were very happy with this experience and service and I would highly recommend to others. Also, we were his only customers in the group which he likes to have it that way. Message Lahiru directly on WhatsApp to book +94 76 272 6799

title: Amazing Safari Experience
text: Instead of buying my partner a Christmas present this year, I decided to buy him an experience when we arrived in Sri Lanka. After lots of research in to different experiences and then wildlife parks and tour guides we were sold on a review of a safari run by Lahiru and we are so glad that we did! Lahiru arranged a driver for the journey to and from the park for us - a really friendly driver and 3 hours each way but totally worth it. When we arrived, Lahiru was able to take us through the routes that weren’t well frequented by the other jeeps which meant we had a more tailored and magical experience. Highlights included seeing lots of baby elephants <3, having elephants within arms reach on several occasions, being the only jeep to witness an elephant crossing the lake whilst two crocodiles were sunbathing at the edge of the water, seeing a huge herd of water buffalo bathing as well as seeing many other birds and animals in a natural habitat. Lahiru’s ability to capture fabulous pictures of the animals on our phones through his binoculars for a real close up of the beautiful animals and his friendly banter really made it a great trip. If you’re looking to do a safari and see lots of animals with a personalised experience (ask for a private tour) then I’d advise that you contact Lahiru to book via Whattsapp +94762726799. Thank you for a fabulous trip Lahiru! :)

title: Udawalawe national park
text: My wife and I went on an afternoon safari with Chaminda, we were very specific that we wanted a quieter tour not harassing animals etc and staying away from the other jeeps where possible. Chaminda to his credit was very professional and careful in his driving and approach of the animals and birds that i think we saw much more than other jeeps that seemed to be racing around. Our guide was very informative, spotting the following: Blue tailed bee eater Malabar pied hornbill Peahens and peacocks Brown headed barbet Mongoose Little green bee eater White bellied sea eagle Changeable hawk eagle Coppersmith barbet Red vented bulbul Green pigeon Imperial pigeon Sri Lanka green pigeon Sirkeer malkoha Crested serpent eagle Rose ringed Parakeets Brown shrike Indian blue Robyn water buffalos wallowing in a pond And of course elephants, some with very young calves. The highlight of our tour was the pied hornbills as I believe these are shy birds so rare sighting. Overall a very enjoyable and informative tour. I can highly recommend Chaminda, give him a ring or text phone No: +94773379470. Cheers Michael and Asha, from Darwin Australia.

title: Fabulous safari with Lahiru
text: After reading other reviews we decided to book directly with Lahiru and we were delighted with our trip. We saw so many elephants including several family groups with baby elephants as young as 2 weeks. We saw lots of other animals and roamed the park on our own, without a flock of jeeps following us. It was so beautiful and peaceful. We saw water buffaloes, golden hyenas, two types of monkeys, a crocodile, wild pigs, star tortoise and many amazing birds including the beautiful bee catcher. Lahiru speaks brilliant English, has a sense of humour and is very knowledgeable about the park and the animals. Highly recommended. Contact Lahiru on what’s app +94 76 272 6799 to find out more.

title: Excellent
text: This was one of the highlights of our visit to Sri Lanka. Arrived at 0630 and spent four amazing hours seeing all sorts of wildlife in a relaxed and positive setting. Our guide was informative and helpful and we saw so many elephants very close up. The elephants didn’t seem harassed in any way and the experience was a real privilege.

title: Safari
text: A must do experience wherever you are in Sri Lanka...we used a reputable courier to book the jeep hire and park fees which cost approximately £70. Pay the bit extra for the more expensive jeep which is more substantially equipped than the cheaper model...believe me, you'll be glad of it on the parks trails, which are very very unstable! Our guide was very informative and pointed out things we would have easily missed, they are incredibly professional and well informed, not to mention exceptional drivers! Within minutes we were in the company of a majestic bull elephant who seemed quite undeterred by our proximity! We booked a couple of hours in the park, enough time to get up close and personal with the famous residents, including deer, water buffalo and a vast array of birds, lizards and mongoose, perhaps a longer tour might have increased our chances of seeing more than the 5 or 6 elephant we did, but by then we'd been bounced around enough! This is well worth the fee and advisable early start, if just to be that close to these magnificent creatures.

title: Chaminda - Fantastic jeep driver/naturalist
text: I had the most fantastic day with Chaminda, and recommend him wholeheartedly. He is polite, professional, sensitive to travellers’ needs and speaks pretty good English. He knows the names of all the animals in English and has reference books in the jeep. Most importantly he is knowledgeable about the creatures in the park and has a very good eye for spotting all manner of birds, mammals, and lizards. You can call him directly on his mobile +94 (077) 337 9470 Chaminda charged me the standard rate for each half day game drive (currently 5,000 rupees) and freely gave me extra time on the morning drive in order to arrive early and beat the long queues, and then added more free extra time at the end too, as he was trying to find a brown fish owl. He spotted so many rare birds for me, and the brown fish owl eluded us on this trip! The afternoons are best for elephants as it’s too hot for birds until late afternoon, when visitors have to exit the park. Here are some of the notable sightings we had over the day: Brown Shrike Yellow eyed babbler (rare) Woolly neck stork Blue faced malkohas (rare) Sirkeer malkohas (rare) Red breasted green pigeon Indian roller Jungle prinia Sikri Great coucal Grey headed fish eagle Kingfisher (common and black capped) Chestnut headed bee eater Little green bee eater Blue tailed bee eater Land monitor lizard Painted storks Plum headed parakeet pair (rare) Hoopoe Crocodiles Serpent eagle Sri Lankan Green pigeon Tufted Grey langur Toque Macaques Mogoose pair Yellow water lapwing Golden jackal Plus common: Many elephants including little babies, lots of fascinating behaviours to observe Peacocks Water buffaloes Egrets Brahminy kites

title: Safari in Udawalawe
text: Having just been on a safari in Udawalawe, we would highly recommend Lahiru as a guide. He spotted many animals we wouldn't have seen and took some amazing photos for us. He and his driver were also good at making sure we weren't in a convoy of other jeeps. The highlight was when they tracked down a family of elephants, including some very cute babies.

title: Nice park with Elephants and local wildlife
text: The main attraction here are the Elephants in the wild, we saw monkeys, lizards, deer and various birds. Don’t come with high expectations this ain’t Africa, but still everyone had a great time and cruising along on Safari jeep was fun for everyone.

title: Baby elephants
text: We did a morning trip and this is a very well organised trip with many companies- perhaps too many as most of the vehicles had 1 or 2 people in , this is nice as you get plenty of space but not good for the environment as you could easily reduce the Impact to both the park and reduce the pollution . Nether the less this place is definitely worth a visit with plenty of wildlife about . We were lucky enough to see a croc ( briefly) , plenty of birds , elephants galore , a mongoose , spiky tortoise , jackals and a curious monkey . Seeing a 2 week old elephant with its mum and 5 yr old sister at a watering hole was the highlight of our holiday ! And our guide was very informative- although he could have spent less time on his mobile and shaking his legs whilst we took pics - also it would have shown more respect to the wildlife. There is not much else in the local area so 1 night stay on plenty .

title: Just another normal park.
text: Is the national park but basically nothing to see. Elephants are easily spotted if you really like them alot. Or else is just a bird park, plenty of peacocks, few types of eagles and bee eating small colourful birds. May see water buffalos chilling in the water hole. Leopard are very rare so no high hopes.

title: Great tour with lahiru
text: Really good tour of the safari park with the best guide. Definitely worth booking in advance and perhaps cost is a bit extra but it’s definitely worth it as he shows you everything that other guides miss and manages to find the best spots for the elephants! +94 76 272 6799

title: Good morning
text: An enjoyable morning. Good value entry and car and guide. We booked through our hotel which was yonan river face (which was fantastic). Saw about ten elephants or so amongst other wildlife. Expect to see more than 10 to be honest... but guess that’s nature! Would recommend getting a guide to give info and spot small animals - eg eagle, birds, etc

title: Best safari tour guide of Udawalawe
text: After reading many good reviews about the tour guide lahiru prasad here on trip advisor we decided to ask him to show us Udawalawe and wow he did not disappoint. He has great knowledge about all the animals and wildlife in the park. He is very friendly and will take you away from other jeeps so you get to experience the park completely alone. He knows lots of good spots and we would highly recommend choosing him as your guide. His WhatsApp number is +94 76 272 6799

title: Amazing Safari
text: Booked the Safari with Iahiru Prasad as our guide and a separate driver. I cannot recommend this tour enough, with the solid Land Rover which was able to reach even the tough spots we saw a lot of animals very close to our Jeep. Many elephants with their small babies, warans, monkeys, many birds and even wild cats. Our guide was very friendly, funny, experienced, spoke very good English and even some German. He had the right feeling where to find all the animals, answered all of our questions and gave us a lot of information at the side. Thanks for this great Safari.

title: We loved it
text: We thoroughly enjoyed two safari visits to the park. Our volunteer guide, Dammy, was excellent, spotted so much wildlife to show us and had lots of interesting information. I liked that safari vehicles didn’t seem to disturb the wildlife here. Everyone had space and time to enjoy the view, it wasn’t crowded.

title: Great Park to see elephants from the closest
text: Within 2 hours we saw so many animals. We got very close to elephants and watch them during their morning routine. We booked via Tuk Tuk Safari Tangalle and were picked up in Ella. Entrance fee is pretty high, but the park offers a unique experience.

title: Lahiru really does a quality tour
text: I didn't really want to book a tour with Lahiru because it seems like everyone's reviews are about him and his prices keep going up. But we really had a great experience with Lahiru!! I would highly recommend him. We saw elephants up so close but really felt like Lahiru respected the animals. We didn't see huge amounts of elephants but saw approx 5 different groups along with water buffalo, crocodiles (!), lizards and 15 different birds. Lahiru's ability to spot wildlife can only come from years of experience. Whenever we came across another jeep, Lahiru went another way so we had a truly private tour the whole 4 hours. We had heard about Lahiru taking photos through his binoculars and I hadn't thought much of it. But Lahiru was so skilled at taking photos with your own phone/camera that you could just focus of looking at the wildlife rather than trying to take a good photo. Lahiru arranged pick up from Ella and then we were dropped off at a beach in the south after the tour. He even organised an extra driver from Ella in the morning because a land slide had blocked a road and the extra driver could navigate a different route. The whole day cost 250 USD for three people. We booked via Whatsapp (+94762726799). Lahiru also brought food for us (but we didn't know that was going to happen so we had brought our own!). Only feedback for Lahiru: tell people you will bring them food, give them more information before the day or when you meet them so they know how the day will run (we knew when we were being picked up and approx how long the tour went for, but when we met Lahiru it was literally just a warm hello and then we didn't know what was happening next - I guess it was just a case of 'let's get on with the safari' but we weren't sure what was going on), and let the people know when the tour is coming to an end (this wasn't clear and we were told we could choose how long we wanted to stay in the park). The time went so fast!

title: If you've been on an African Safari, you'll be very disappointed. If you love elephants, you'll enjoy it!
text: After having been on safari in Botswana, this was a total let down. We ultimately only saw elephants, peacocks, and a bunch of birds. Our whole group got tired of seeing peacocks, and there wasn't much else to see. More annoyingly, the park felt small and we'd constantly be around 5-7 jeeps at a time circling around an animal. It felt unnatural and unkind to the animal. If you've never been on safari though, I'd recommend it as a great way to spend a morning (no more than four hours is needed). The elephants are a delight to see and it's great to be in nature. The peacocks are very pretty too.

title: Amazing trip arranged by Walawa Blue Sapphire
text: This was my favourite safari I have done so far and we got very close to two beautiful elephants as well as seeing a group a little further away. Also saw lots of other animals and birds. I would definitely recommend staying at Walawa Blue Sapphire hotel if you are visiting the National Park. They arranged everything at a very competitive price and the staff and food were exceptional!

title: Excellent safari guide - we spotted a leopard!
text: We booked our safari through Mansala Safari House and went for the full day option. At the park entrance, we were greeted by Lionel, one of the volunteer guides (note that this is an additional cost) and we are very happy to have had him with us - he has eagle eyes, quite literally, as he pointed out eagles and other wild birds we would otherwise have missed, and even spotted small lizards high up in trees and a tiny musk deer deep in the undergrowth. Elephants, of course, are easier to spot and we met plenty along the way. Our driver and guide were both fairly respectful of their space, and although all the vehicles in the park are quite noisy, the wildlife in general seemed relatively undisturbed. In the afternoon, we were incredibly excited to see a leopard and as there were no other jeeps around, we stood for 5 to 10 minutes observing him. Something I think we’ll never forget! Our guide and driver were almost as excited as we were by this rare sighting. It was clearly our lucky day, as we later came across a jungle cat. I’d heartily recommend a visit to the Udawalawe National Park and if you stay at the Mansala Safari House, they send you off with the most delicious lunch, even catering for vegans like us! Total cost for two people in one jeep, with driver, was USD 130 (23,400 LKR). Lionel’s services were additional, with a voluntary and discretionary contribution.

title: Awesome Safari with Lahiru and 4WD
text: We texted Lahiru 3days before the planned tour date and arranged the safari. The day of the Safari we spent the night at his brothers place. We had great food there. Lahiru picked us up from the hotel at 5am. The safari cost 100 USD in total for Lahiru, driver, jeep and entrance fee (2 persons). The safari was great, we could take numerous elephants, water buffalos, deer, jackals, crocodiles and different bird species from the closest proximity on remote ways apart from other tourists. Due to the fact that his Jeep was so much better than the others we could go to places noone else could go. This, we were able to see crocodiles as well. He helped us to take great photos and took a lot of time to explain the animals of the national park to us with humor in love English as well as in German. The safari was definitely worth its money. Lahiru is also happy to help you plan your onward journey at local prices. He brought us to the next bus station to get our transfer to Tangalle. So beware of scammers. Someone is steeling lahirus identity due to his good reputation. Just text him: Lahiru Safari : 076 - 2726799

title: Safari
text: Having come all the way to Sri Lanka from London, we wanted to ensure that we had first class experiences, including this safari. Our daughter has researched the park (here in TripAdvisor), and found excellent reviews for Lahiru (tel and WA: +94 76 272 6799). This was not cheap by any means, but we felt worth every penny. Firstly, our guide Lahiru was extremely knowledgeable, interesting, animated and fun.His English was first class and easy to understand. Secondly, we had a separate driver, so Lahiru was concentrating on spotting the wildlife rather than driving. Then, another hero was the Land Rover Defender - a clear step up from nearly all other vehicles, as it is a proper 4-wheel drive, with the ability to get places the others just could not even think of. That, together with an obviously experienced and skilled driver. At one point, we couldn't get up a muddy river bank, resorting to the front winch to pull us up. After that experience, we managed to get to an area to enjoy a lake area with basking crocodiles, which was the cherry on top of this excellent experience.

title: Fantastic national park
text: We book the jeep with Usaj, from Avian Garden Guest house. It is very recommended as they care a lot about the tour and the tourists. The explained us many information about the animals and trees we crossed. The park has many elephants, buffalos and different birds. During the morning - at 6.00am - is the best time to see the animals. It was our first Safari and we enjoyed a lot!

title: Wonderful park and guidare visit
text: The park Is beautiful. Many Elephants living on their own in a wild environment. Thanks to Usaj from Avian Garden Guest House Who organized out visit and stayed with us, the experience was great. Highly recommended the park and his house and services. Aviangardenu@gmail.com +94 766203016

title: Fantastic park and beautiful animals!
text: We went to this stunning park in between 3pm and 7pm and it took 10 minutes to find some gentle giants! They were so calm grazing near the dirt roads of the park and were not fearful of us. We decided to go with just a driver and not a guide as I had heard guides are expensive and do not bring much to the experience. The driver was a great guide explaining what we were seeing and making sure we got the best views without being in danger or stressing the animals. You could see the driver really cared for the animals. I would highly recommend going in the evening and not first thing in the morning. Tours are advertised as the best in the morning but I guarantee we saw just as much in the evening and there were very few tourists in the park, whereas in the morning hundreds arrive at once.

title: Great safari with Lahiru
text: We booked Lahiru after reading many TripAdvisor reviews. He has a Land Rover vehicle which is capable of navigating areas of the park that other vehicles are unable to - so you get to see a lot more animals and closer than usual. He was nice to bring us coffee and some snacks as well. He had a lot of knowledge about the park, knew a lot about the animals and was able to spot them from really far away. He kept us entertained throughout the safari and told us a lot of trivia about the park and animals. We had a really good safari experience - thanks to Lahiru! Highly recommend.

title: Lahiru Safari
text: Magic trip trough Udawalawe with Lahiru & his driver! His enormous knowledge, hawk eyes and a really good sense of humour made it to a legendary adventure. He spotted animals from about 100m, we didn’t even saw 5m away. His defender 4x4 is unique and we got though the toughest mud and jungle to find crocodiles, elephant so close you can touch and much more. So you gotta book Lahiru for your next safari trip in Udawalawe. Best via whatsapp. +94 76 272 6799

title: Amazing Experience
text: The park is an amazing experience We paid to have a jeep just for us and I would say it is worth that bit of extra money to not have to share the photo ops and be able to move from side to side We had a guide but they are not vital if you have a good driver. The guides English was poor and he just used a book to show is the birds but he was good at spotting the Elephants and knowing which way to go, although the drivers all share sightings as you move round Seeing these magnificent creatures up close is mesmerizing We did the 0630 trip so you see them moving round to take cover for the day ahead - it was just great

title: Great elephant experience
text: We took a whole day safari & so got to see all aspects of the park; grasslands where we saw many wonderful, magical elephants, it was phenomenal & monkeys; also went to wetlands area to see water buffalo & water birds; the river to see many crocs; the different forests where we saw jackals & deer; & of course loads of magnificent peacocks & other birds; the pace was leisurely & we got to see so many elephants & had the time to sit (in the Jeep!) to just watch them eat, swim, play & take great care of their young; we even saw a rare tusker - a brilliant day in the park - we wanted to see elephants up close & we did; expectations exceeded!

title: What a great experience
text: Did a Jeep Safari through the national park. Our driver was amazing and pointed out many of little things we may not have noticed if trying to find ourselves. Was such an amazing experience and many elephants ventured very close to our vehicle.

title: Mother and baby elephant so close
text: We 2 A 2 C ( aged 8 &10) had an excellent time here. We watched a mother elephant feeding a baby less than a Metre away plus saw 11 other animals. Unforgettable

title: Best safari trip ever!
text: After researching many reviews on here, a name was repeated all the time for tours. We contacted Lahiru and organised the trip via what’s app. Very easy and quick. The next day he picked us up at anantara hotel Tangalle where we were staying on time. Honestly I thought we would see some elephants, from afar and that’s it. Lahiru delivered that and more. Not only did we see elephants but they were so close I could Practically kiss them. He also went off the beaten track and took us places where the other jeeps could not go, as his car was the best by far. We ended up in the middle of the park with nothing but animals around us. Incredible. I admire Lahiru’s passion, effort and he went out of his way to show us elephants, crocodiles, buffalo, deer and all the birds in the park. This was truly amazing experience and I highly recommend him to anyone. Our 4 year old son was amazed that he finally saw the animals he had been reading about in books. Call +94 76 272 6799 Lahiru You will not be disappointed.

title: Amazing 4x4 Tour of Stunning National Park with Lahiru!
text: First of all, the park itself is stunning. Tons of open space for the animals to roam freely and filled with lush vegetation and lakes. It was easy to see elephants from afar upon arriving. However, what really makes the difference is your driver and guide. I had read some mixed reviews about finding a driver upon arrival, so I wanted to make sure I had an excellent driver and guide. I'm a solo budget traveler and I'm very careful about what a splurge on but I read numerous reviews of Lahiru on TripAdvisor so I thought I would contact him. Immediately, he was helpful, friendly and professional, giving me a clear layout of the price and what was included. I needed transport from Hirikitiya and then onwards to Ella and he gave me a clear breakdown of the price for everything. The transport between cities was the lowest rate I received. And while Lahiru's rates are not the cheapest, they are a very reasonable price considering you have him as a guide with an additional driver as well (not to mention the quality of his tour). I was hesitant but I decided to book with him and I'm so glad I did. It was one of my favorite days of my trip so far. Lahiru was so knowledgable and an expert as spotting wildlife and giving me information. Upon entrance to the park, we spotted a huge variety of species. Additionally, thanks to the Landrover, we were able to access areas of the park that most other trucks could not. There were numerous times where we were the only truck around. We managed to get so incredibly close to the elephants while still respecting the park rules and regulations. There was plenty of time for photos (which, if you didn't bring a DSLR, Lahiru will help you snap photos with his binoculars and your smartphone!) and to just enjoy as well. I never felt rushed and was always asked if I wanted more time before moving on. Driving by most of the other jeeps, tourists seemed bored while they stuck to the main road (and drivers asked Lahiru where we had seen animals!). But Lahiru kept me entertained the entire time with info about the animals and his great sense of humor. If I wasn't laughing, I was in awe at all the amazing animals we were seeing. Time really flew by. If I had more time in my schedule, it would have been great to do a camping experience but I'll have to save that for when I return one day! I've traveled to a lot of countries and almost never write Trip Advisor reviews but Lahiru is one of the best guides I've had and made my time in the park an incredible memory. If you're on the fence about splurging, trust me it's worth it! His info: lahiru.jpdk@gmail.com +94 76 272 6799

title: Very good Safari with Lahiru
text: We went today with the Guide Lahiru into the Nationalpark to do a halfday safari. It was Amazing and we have Seen a lot of animals. He has good eyes and is a very careful Driver. We can recomend him as Guide to 100%. Number: +94 76 272 6799

title: lahiru Prasad 07627267
text: Me and my partner had our tour with Liharu after being recommended him by a friend. Liharu and his driver were very accommodating getting us morning snacks and telling us where we could stop to use the toilet. We cannot fault the safari experience, we saw lots of animals including elephant and crocodile, and liharu told us we had taken a quieter route away from other jeeps. Liharu has a good eye for spotting and has knowledge about the animals-I think he enjoys his job. This was the most expensive part of our who trip to Sri Lanka; costing £160 to pick up from Ella,safari jeep with 2 other people, and drop off in Tangelle-but we felt it was worth it? After having done our tour however, we did feel very hastled to leave a review, receiving multiple WhatsApp messages for days after asking where is our review, whilst we were wanting to enjoy our holiday and review when we get back home.

title: Excellent park with Excellent naturalist
text: We had the most amazing safari with Mansala. We saw many elephants including a baby feeding from its mother, we saw water buffalo,deer, monkeys, mongoose, crocodiles, lots of birds and a very rare anteater! Era's knowledge was extensive and he was generous with his time and sharing his knowledge with the family. He was committed to ensuring we had the best experience possible whilst also respecting and protecting the animals. Era and his driver’s familiarity with the park meant we did not encounter many other jeeps and we felt safe with the drivers skills the entire time.??Contact Mansala Safari through WhatsApp +94777959090.

title: One of the best tour in srilanka with Mansala
text: We booked through Mansala for the safari and it was a great experience. We could see many Elephants, deer, buffalos, crocodiles, birds... Era speaks great English and has a good eye to spot animals. Most of the time we drove around alone (there are packs of jeeps) thanks to his knowledge of the park. we totally recommend to book with them. Also Mansala is very reachable on WhatsApp which makes things easy to arrange +94777959090... we did it from Leeds just before trip

title: Great Safari with Leel
text: The safari we did with Leel was amazing. We saw many animals including elephants and deers. Leel was very knowledgable about the animals and explained us about their habits and characteristics. In contrast to the safari we did in Sigiriya, we could see the elephants from close by without being surrounded by 50 other jeeps. Leel also made sure that we saw all nice places in the park and made sure we had nice pictures. In summery, we really enjoyed our safari with Leel and definitely recommend it.

title: Close elephant encounters!
text: If you want to see elephants then this is amazing! But if you want the traditional safari big 5 this isn't the place to go, I've heard Yala National Park has leopards but it was closed when we were in Sri Lanka. We had a great morning at the park. Meant leaving our hotel at 4am but so worth it to feel comfortable as the temperature was so nice and cool! Such a difference from what we experienced in the daytime! My cousin organised this so afraid I don't have contact details for who we used! As soon as we entered the park we could see elephants in the distance. As we drove past a track our drivers stopped and reversed as they'd caught an elephant coming up the path out of the corner of their eyes! Their attention to the smallest creatures is amazing! This elephant was coming right towards us and walked past the jeeps, an experience I won't forget. Other animals: water buffalo, chameleons, lots of birds in trees, monkeys in an area we stopped in. Great for kids, we had my cousins children (age 4 and 6) who loved spotting all the animals!

title: Guided Tour with Lahiru and his Land Rover
text: We visited Udawalawe National Park by booking a guided tour. Our tourguide was Lahiru and it was absolutly amazing!! We found his contact at TripAdvisor. Everthing was well organized (we also booked a transfer from Ella to Udawalawe and a transfer from Udawalawe to Tangalle with Lahiru). Due to the fact that he uses a 4-wheel drive for his Safari we were able to visit also the very muddy places at Udawalawe National Park where other guided tours weren't able to go. So we could observe a lot of animals (elephants, crocodiles, peacocks, water buffalos, monkeys, a lot of birds, etc.) in an undisturbed environmente. Lahiru explained a lot about the animals and the history of Udawalawe and we had enough time to take a lot of pictures. If you ever think about visiting Udawalawe National Park I highly recommend you to join him for a Safari. Just text him via WhatsApp (+94762726799) or contact him by Mail (lahiru.jpdk@gmail.com) and explain what you want to see and he will arrange everything for you!! If we will come back to Sri Lanka one day we will definitely go for a Safari with him again!

title: Good experience
text: We went in the afternoon slot around 3.30 P.M but unfortunately didnt see a lot of animals other than elephants. It also started raining heavily about an hour after we entered so we had to cover the vehicle, reducing our visibility. While we saw lots and lots of elephants, we werent lucky enough to see the other animals that other reviewers have seen. To be honest though, the elephants themselves were completely worth the money and my children had a wonderful time. A couple of tips - if you get quotes from a few guys and go asking further down the road, you will invariably get a cheaper rate. However you will spend time doing this, which means that you might save 1 or 2 thousand LKR but lose out on safari time, so the savings arent really worth it. My recommendation is to plan ahead, check with a few operators and book a safari the previous day. Try to go early and reschedule if heavy rains are predicted. Just for information - the pricing model is like this: the operator will either offer an all-in rate (inclusive of jeep and entrance tickets) or will offer his jeep for a certain price and ask you to buy tickets on your own (you need to specifically ask for the second option). The price of the jeep will be approximately LKR 6000 for 3 hours, which you can try and negotiate. The price is for the whole jeep (6 seater), regardless of the number of people, so you can team up with other guests at your hotel and reduce the per-person cost.

title: Heavenly morning with Buddhi and the Birds
text: We’d read so many great reviews about Buddhi on Trip Advisor and were so glad that today’s technology allowed us to arrange the trip with Buddhi in advance from England. Further, having Buddhi as a WhatsApp contact before the trip truly saved us from a lot of stress when the driver which we had organised from our hotel to pick us up at 6am failed to turn up (driver was not associated with Buddhi or our hotel - he was someone who had sold his services to us on the beach and let us down). I was so distraught that our driver had not turned up and that we would not make it to our 6.20am appointment with Buddhi, having woken our 3 and 7 year old children up at 5.30am! Then I remembered I had Buddhi’s phone number and contacted him on WhatsApp. He greeted us with the biggest smile on my phone screen and calmed me down. Buddhi arranged a tuk tuk for us from Kalametiya to pick us up from our hotel and we were there shortly after 7am (normally it would have made sense to get transport from our end, but we had no idea at that early hour how to arrange it when our driver did a no-show on us). Despite the delay, which meant that by the end of our excursion with Buddhi the morning was much hotter than it would have been if we’d finished an hour earlier, as scheduled, and the water was moving a bit more (meaning that Buddhi and his helper had to row harder), Buddhi was all smiles the whole trip and is simply the nicest person who made us feel so special and welcome in his lake paradise. The bird watching itself was incredibly relaxing and interesting, both for ourselves, as adults, and our two children. 2 weeks on, our 3 year old is still saying “bird watching was sooo fun”. We all learnt to recognise many birds and also went on a little jungle walk and climbed a rock! I actually have a terrible fear of heights and stopped half way (it really was not that high!) but my 7 year old who is also scared of heights climbed it liked a mountain goat and Buddhi carried our 3 year old up and down. The view from the top was spectacular my husband tells me. I would recommend this trip to both experienced bird watchers who get the chance to witness the birds in such a peaceful place (we were the only ones there at the time) and to novices who want to experience the beauty of this lake with all its water flowers, birds and other animals. Thank you Buddhi for a lovely morning, which we are still reliving through photos on a daily basis! Ps none of the birds or animals appeared to be affected by our presence at all, and we just felt privileged to be a part of the peaceful morning lake scene.

title: Something different

We also saw monkeys in the trees, lizards and a water buffalo. You are given the opportunity to wade through shallow water (ankle deep) to the land and climb up on top of a massive rock. The panoramic views from the top are beautiful. Budi served us fresh watermelon and water about half way through the morning. At the conclusion of the trip you are provided with a list of all the birds you have seen on your tour. It is a unique and interesting tour that we would highly recommend.

title: Buddhi is the best!
text: We arrived via cruise ship so were later than optimal for viewing the maximum number of birds (usually Buddhi starts at 6 AM and we started around 9:30 AM). Despite that, Buddhi did a fantastic job for us--due to his keen eyes (and those of his friend, who was poling the pontoon boat through the mangroves), we were able to spot and quickly identify reclusive birds: 50 different species! It was so quiet and peaceful as we glided through the water, with many stops for sightings. Too many highlights to mention, but a couple include seeing Sri Lanka's largest kingfisher as well as every variety of egret - all at once!!!! - riding on the backs of swimming water buffaloes! Buddhi provided excellent high power binoculars, bird books, water and fresh watermelon as a snack midway through the tour. He is quite musical, too - played a traditional flute-like instrument for us on the way back. After our tour, we were invited to his home for refreshments: homemade fresh fruit smoothies (made from fruit from their own trees), thin coconut filled dosas and crisp fried (not sweet) 'cookies' or biscuits. Yum! Later, Buddhi sent us a wonderful memory of our trip that he filmed during our time with him. Tip: Buddhi arranged our transport from the ship to Kalametiya for us. We chose an A/C car (which took about 1/2 hour). This is definitely the right choice. We could have had a tuk-tuk but it would have taken a lot longer and not as comfortable. To sum it up: We could not have been happier. Great alternative to Hambantota choices closer to the ship.

title: Fantastic trip, great tour guide
text: We fancied doing something a little different whilst on the South Coast of Sri Lanka, and a bird-watching tour seemed like a good thing to try. We couldn’t be happier with our choice - the trip was both enjoyable and educational, and our tour guide, Buddhi, was extremely friendly. We got up at 5am to take a tuk tuk (at 05.30am) from Tangalle to the location of the tour, in Kalametiya. The tuk tuk driver was organised by Buddhi, and he was super friendly (he even gave us some free tea on the way). Buddhi’s passion for the birds was very evident, which certainly rubbed off on us too. Buddhi was also happy to answer any questions we had. Moreover, this is more than just a birdwatching tour. Halfway through the trip, we got out of the boat and climbed to the top of a rock which looked out over the water. The views are incredible. Free snacks and drinks were provided too. I strongly recommend this trip for anyone who’s interested in birdwatching. But I also recommend the trip for anyone who just wants to do something different and experience the beauty of Sri Lanka.

title: We Are Glad We Took This Tour!!
text: On our 6 day trip to down south, we decided to devote half a day to do a bird watching tour in Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary. From a recommendation of a friend, we selected Buddhi as our host. The choice we made was excellent because the tour was a highlight in our entire trip. Here are the reasons why you should do this tour and why you should do it with Buddhi. 1. Buddhi knows his stuff well. The birds, the best timing to watch birds, habitats and everything you can think of. 2. Even if you go empty handed, knowing nothing, he will give you leaflets to refer, binoculars and even refreshments! 3. He will take his time and try to show you everything possible. So, the money you pay is worth paying. 4. He will give you the best experience and he will make sure you will enjoy it to the extreme. He took us to the rocky hillock on the side of the lagoon. When you climb to the top, you can see a 360 view of everything around you and mind you, it’s amazing! 5. He will give every chance to take pictures, even if you are not a photographer. 6. He can play the flute well. He will play you a tune when you are about to end the tour. Imagine hearing flute music early in the morning while you are floating in a boat, surrounded by nature! That’s wonderful. 7. At the end of the tour, he will get together with you and mark all the birds you saw in a sheet and that’s like a record book. 8. Buddhi is one of the most humble and amazing personality and he will make sure to give you the best of it. If we go there again, we will definitely go to him again. Even if you go the same tour again, I am pretty sure it will be interested every time

title: Hidden Gem
text: I had read about visiting the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary and am so thrilled we decided to go. Its certainly a hidden gem for those who love to see birds! We saw over 44 kinds of birds and were able to get some wonderful photos. Buddhi was absolutely the best guide. I started calling him superman as he really has incredible hearing and sight and could see the rare species and direct us to it. He is a wonderful guide with a wealth of knowledge and passion for the area! He is also a great flute player we got to know and made a really great real time video of our experience!! Would highly recommend visiting and exploring with Buddhi!

title: Pleasant afternoon with Buddhi!
text: We spent a good time with Buddhi and his friend, He seems very passionate about birds and full of surprise! We spend a pleasant and peaceful time with him watching the beauty of nature ,

title: A fantastic trip brought alive by Buddhi's enthusiasm
text: My wife and I went on a fantastic two and a half hour trip with Buddhi and his friend Hashan (who rowed the boat). This was our first time birding, and Buddhi's enthusiasm and knowledge really brought the landscape to life as we observed and learned about all the different species of bird in this picturesque wetland reserve. We saw 53 different species of bird in one morning (everything from herons to kingfishers - and even a monitor lizard) amazing! They supply everything you need - binoculars, water, snacks - and can arrange transport from your hotel. Buddhi even played a little tune on the flute on our way back which was a nice touch. This was a glorious trip and a real highlight of our holiday in Sri Lanka.

title: Incredible Experience!
text: The combination of excellent birding and stunning scenery made this tour with our guide, Buddhi, an experience i will never forget! Buddhi is very enthusiastic, a smile on his face at all times. He also has an incredibly sharp eye and can spot birds excellently and identify them instantly. We saw 62+ species from 6am onwards, watching the beautiful sunrise surrounded by hundreds of birds. I highly recommend Buddhi and his business and this tour is a must for any nature enthusiast in Sri Lanka. Many thanks to Buddhi for this unforgettable birding trip!

title: Excellent tour!
text: We absolutely loved the tour of Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary with Buddhi. He was able to organise a 6am tour for us at very short notice (night before), it was well organised and a lovely experience for birders and non-birders alike. Buddhi is very knowledgeable about the local birds and a pleasure to spend a few hours with. Highly recommended.

title: Unforgettable, unmissable.
text: This tour has been an absolute highlight of our trip. We took a peaceful ride through the sanctuary, whilst Buddhi took his time to explain and show us as many of the birds as possible, whilst also explaining the area. We went in the afternoon and I can certainly recommend doing the same if only for the beautiful sunset on the rock at the end. It was a very special moment. As we slowly returned Buddhi played for us on the flute, together with the scenery it was a magical ending. Thoroughly worth the visit, do not hesitate to book with these guys. Thank you!!

title: Excellent birdwatching trip
text: We travelled in a punt on a large lagoon and saw many interesting birds.The location is beautiful and tranquil. A pleasant way to spend time even if you're not very interested in birds. Our guide Buddhi was excellent: knowledgeable, personable and conscientious. His email is info@kalametiyabirds.lk

title: WONDERFUL
text: Go there. That's incredible, and every nature lover will be amazed :) Many different birds, guides that help you understand what birds are there, where they are (they really have a good eye !) GO THERE :)

title: Pleasantly surprised
text: Buddhi was very nice and accommodating throughout. He has an impressive knowledge and a sharp eye for birds while the rest of us took awhile to spot them even with binoculars provided. He had little surprises along the way which made it a truly memorable experience. He also took us to some dry land and climbed up a rock overlooking the beautiful sanctuary (you'll be stepping barefoot in some shallow waters). It can get quite sunny but umbrellas are provided. All in all very pleasant and relaxing. I'll be happy to go back there again. Keep it up, Buddhi :)

title: The best!
text: We came on this boat Safari tour with our local guide who recommended it as the best! It really was: we started early at 6am and met Buddhi who gave us a wonderful experience. We saw over 60 different birds both from his boat and from a high rock overlooking the whole wetland. He was kind and helpful - we are seniors - very knowledgeable, well equipped and also provided light refreshments. Binoculars were available as well as bird books. We were shown photos of the birds that we had seen to reinforce our memorys. As we returned after 21⁄2 hours, he played haunting tunes on his Sri Lankan flute. Altogether we had a wonderful experience. I would highly recommend these tours in the peace and beauty of the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary.

title: Wow wow wow
text: My wife and myself went today on this tour and I must say it was one of the highlights of our trip. We saw 50 different species of bird and our guide Buddhi was amazing. He’s only a young man but he has amazing knowledge and more importantly he has a big heart and is a very likable man. There are “tours” and there are “tours” and this was certainly the latter. This trip should be one of the first on your list. Highly recommended

title: Awesome Experience
text: The Bird Watching Tour was one of our highlights during our 3 weeks stay in Sri Lanka. The tour took about 2,5 hours and started at 6:15am in the morning. We went there by scooter from Tangalle by our own with no problem (30min ride). The boat ride on the lagoon during sunrise was amazing. We also climbed up a rock and had a great view. Our tour guide Buddhi is a very polite and positive person. He has such a great knowledge about birds. Very brilliant. We really enjoyed the tour and can highly recommend it.

title: Best tour
text: Awesome tour! So many birds, calmness, adventure and meditation all in one! We enjoyed it so much and will definitely do it again! Thank you

title: Buddhi you are a star
text: This is our third boat tour over a number of years at Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary with Buddhi.He has an absolutely delightful infectious and fun personality.He is a passionate environmentalist and has respect for the fragile ecosystem where he operates his tours. He takes you along a magic journey where his ability to spot birds and with his encyclopaediac knowledge describe them in detail holds your attention. Obviously the last few years have been tough for guides like Buddhi who in spite of the challenges remains firmly positive and we must cherish his expertise You are a very special person Buddhi and such a model to your generation as your character personality principles and respect for those you engage with ticks all the boxes

title: A morning on the lagoon with Buddhi is one you will not forget ...
text: If you enjoy spending time in an unspoiled natural outdoor setting where you feel like you are the only human soul for miles around, be sure to put Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary on the itinerary for your next visit to southern Sri Lanka - and absolutely hire Buddhi as your guide. We did, and the morning we spent on the lagoon with him and the able pilot of our little catamaran (which is piled through the lagoon’s winding channels - no motors around ...) was the highlight of our trip! We aren’t birders, per se, but Buddhi’s passion for the birds of Kalametiya is infectious. Never have we had a more engaging, entertaining guide on such an outing - and we have been on many. And while his birding knowledge and skills are first rate, he has also mastered a local type of flute (he serenaded us with a couple of songs during our safari), he can turn lotus flowers into necklaces, and he’ll amaze you with magical tricks. And be sure to give him your phone if your photographic skills leave something to be desired - Buddhi will make you look like a National Geographic photographer with the photos and incredible videos he takes! We did a morning excursion and will remember the sunrise from the top of a large granite boulder offering views over the entire lagoon for a long time to come. It was a truly wonderful morning that we couldn’t recommend more highly ...

title: Great afternoon in the lagoon
text: The excursion was really good. The guide is super nice and the birds and landscape are incredible. Very good option if you are in the south area of the country, definitely recommended!

title: Glide through the waters for peace and birdwatching
text: We did an early morning tour, leaving at 6am. The early start was well worth it, to enjoy the tranquility of the waters and the amazing array of birdlife' Gayan provides binoculars and drinking water. He shares his great knowledge of the birdlife of the area, and points out the different species that can be seen. Highlights for us were a close view of a spoonbill, and a glimpse of a yellow bittern. We also enjoyed a snack of bananas and biscuits, made by Gayan's mother. It's worth having a sun hat and sun cream.

title: What a stunning afternoon
text: Had read about this place, booked a 4pm tour and travelled over from the Anantara with two kids aged 8 and 11. So glad we did. Gayan was our guide and took us out with a boatman on a little catamaran. Was a bit unsure at first that it would get boring for the kids but they loved it. Binoculars supplied for all and Gayan was patient with our complete lack of bird knowledge. Was amazing soaking up the atmosphere especially as sunset approached. Saw an incredible number of amazing bird life plus buffalo wandering in the mangrove. Whole place exuded zen and we left feeling we’d seen something very special. An incredible visit and very good value too ($45 for the whole family for 2.5 hrs).

title: Amazing experience
text: Amazing experience with Buddhi. We had no expectation and what a great time we spend on bird watching. Buddhi is great man with a shiny smile who gave us so many information about bird spieces. And also he had a surprise for us ?? highly recommended

title: Just Amazing.............
text: It was a beautiful tour, at sunrise, in a real natural paradise ..... My guide, Gayan, whom I recommend to everyone with all my heart, was a great help to me, because he is a very good local wildlife-birds specialist. It was something like a dream, something I will never forget for the rest of my life....

title: Magical experience seeing over 20 bird species!
text: Our guide Buddhi was extremely knowledgeable and had an eagle eye when it came to spotting the birds. He provided binoculars and books to show us the species we saw from afar, and along the way he even treated us to some flute-playing! It was a thoroughly relaxing and enjoyable experience, and seeing the sun rise over the reserve was just beautiful.

title: Awesome experience
text: As an adult family of 7 we thoroughly enjoyed this experience - it was one of the highlights of our two week stay in Sri Lanka and we are in no way bird watchers! Buddhi and his brother were fantastic guides and we saw 40+ different species whilst being paddled around the beautiful waterways as the sun set. The climb up the rock was fab - a definitely spiritual place. Very highly recommended if you love nature, want to get off the beaten track and are into sustainable tourism - a really genuine experience. Thanks Buddhi for some wonderful memories:) BTW I think the previous reviewer must have been talking about something else!

title: Simply amazing!!
text: This activity was excellent! We saw loads of birds and it was completely eco friendly. We watched sunset from a rock and had a wonderful time. The staff were knowledgable and very friendly! Thank you for an amazing experience!

title: Trip to Kalametiya Bird Santuary
text: We had a wonderful trip to the sanctuary with Bodhi. Even though we arrived late he was courteous and made sure that we saw as much as we could in the time available. What made the trip so special was to witness the passion that Bodhi has for nature and birds in particular, as amateurs we were inspired to spend more time at this gentle and mindful activity. The lagoon itself is stunning, with exotic birds at every turn - truly a highlight of our short holiday....

title: Amazing trip with lovely people
text: We started our tour at 3:30pm which is perfect to catch the sunset from the viewpoint there. We saw over 30 different species of birds. The guides were very knowledgable and super friendly. They don’t use petrol engines and really care about preserving the area. Bhuddi and his team were amazing! Would recommend to anyone who loves animals and nature or just a fun trip :)

title: Boat trip
text: We had an awesome guide - Buddhi, who loves birds and knows a lot of them. Moreover, he could see them everywhere. Buddhi equipped us with binoculars and we were able to see the smallest birds and their baby birds. The funniest part was climbing the rock - it has very good views. In total, we have seen 38 birds, some with baby birds in 2 hours thanks to our guide!

title: Special tour of the beautiful Kalametiya lagoon
text: We spent a beautiful afternoon at the Kalametiya lagoon viewing a multitude of birds by boat with Buddhi, our host, who expertly pointed out birds of all shapes and sizes in and around the lagoon. He provided binoculars for us to use and we traveled on a quiet boat around the lagoon, powered only by his friendly crew using poles. We highly recommend this tour for anyone who loves nature and special places. It was the perfect way to round out our trip to Sri Lanka. We also left with some amazing bird photos. Not to be missed!

title: Awesome experience
text: If you are into animals this is a must do! We booked a morning trip, arrived at 6am and at 6:15am we were on the boat. Buddhi and 2 other friends/guides were the most friendly people we have met so far and especially Buddhi really knew what he was talking about. After a few minutes on the water we already saw a lot of really nice birds and Buddhi kept on pointing to them, they were everywhere! Also they told us a lot about the background of the lagoon and how the Tsunami in 2004 changed the scenery around there. In total we saw around 55 species of birds. I can’t recommend this enough, go do this!

title: Just makes you smile
text: We did a lot of things during our trip in Sri Lanka, but we didnt had a boattour to see the beatiful birds yet. We thought lets try it and enjoy nature. Wow! It was so quiet and so serene. Our guide Buddhi knows so much of all the birds. He always smiles and and is always super excited to tell us about the birds he spotted or the surroundings. It just gives you a smile on your face. In the middle of the tour buddhi asked if he could change boats with his brother so buddhi could share his enthousiasm also with a little birdwatcher on the other boat :). The brother was also super nice and always laughing. We loved that!!! We could even try to paddle ourselves through nature. Nice experience to do! The tour ended by climbing a big black rock, where we could see the whole surroundings from above. Just experience yourself!

title: Wonderful, relaxing, family experience
text: You should make a point of taking a trip with Buddhi at this gem of a place. Even in the non-migratory season, we visited on 29th July'18, we still spotted well over 40 species of birds. Part of the safari was on a comfortable punt boat and part on foot on and around a rocky outcrop, mid voyage. All the time Buddhi points out birds of all types from great distances, just by eye sight, whilst we need our binoculars, though many of the birds are comfortable with us coming quite close, as the boat is so quiet, having no engine. Apparently, early mornings are slightly better for bird numbers, but we did an afternoon / evening trip and saw lots and enjoyed the setting sun over the lake and landscape. The price is very reasonable and the duration a good 3 hours and no rushing, and a local fisherman punts the boat whilst Buddhi concentrates on the tour. We are a family with two late teens boys, and they enjoyed the safari in equal measure. We only had one pair of binoculars of our own, but Buddhi lent us 3 other pairs, so we missed nothing. I suggest you do this as your second safari in Sri Lanka rather than going to two of the wildlife parks. Good English spoken by Buddhi, along with passionate info about the birds and the location, and a check list of the birds we saw, to take away. We booked ahead of time, by direct email, and all went very smoothly. Enjoy your visit!

title: fantastic birds up close
text: Indian darters, herons, ibis, egrets, sea eagle and even a hawk eagle to mention just a few. Seen on a quiet boat moved by pole, it was lovely and I got some fantastic bird in flight photos.

title: Wonderful trip with Buddhi
text: This was an absolute highlight of my trip to Sri Lanka. Buddhi, like me, is really passionate about birds and it was wonderful to spend three hours out on this beautiful stretch of water seeing so many birds including painted storks, pied, common, white-throated and stork kingfishers, even a redshank. In all we saw 57 species - in the low season. He was a great guide and took us all around the lake on a punt pushed by his colleague. He also had great high quality spare binoculars. If you are in Kalaymetiya go with Buddhi to see the birds.

title: Birds, binoculars and biscuits
text: This was not part of our itinerary until we stumbled across the reviews on tripadvisor. And thought it would be a good morning stop off from Tangelle to Yala, and we weren’t disappointed. Buddhi greeted us, and even offered to look after our big bags whilst we went on the tour. The conservation area is 500m from his house, and is well worth the walk as Buddhi started spotting birds immediately. We were provided with binoculars, biscuits, water bottles. And Buddhi had a number of bird books with him for reference, although his knowledge of the bird species impressed us. The conservation area is unspoilt and although it was out of season we spotted 48 species of bird and some monkeys. Great tour, great experience and great guide!

title: Picture Perfect, Hidden Gem!
text: This is a hidden gem of Sri Lanka, the perfect place to experience the beautiful birds with out the humdrum of jeep engines. Located on a peaceful lagoon, we travelled the tranquil waters and bore witness to an aviary. There was a plethora of different birds, an absolute birders paradise. Painted Stork, Spot-billed Pelicans and even several glimpses of the rare Black Bittern. Buddhi knows his birds and nature, he truly enjoy his vocation and shares his knowledge and expertise with you. I have to admit a bit of envy at him having such a beautiful spot as an “office”. Buddhi challenged us to count how many different species we saw, we failed miserably; there was just too many! We would truly recommend this place to anyone who wants to see the beauty of Sri Lanka's wildlife in an intimate and non invasive way.

title: Unpredictably fantastic
text: Udawalawe?????????????????????? ????Buddi??????????????????????????? ??????????????????????????????????????360???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? We stopped by the place from udawalawe national park to galle. Even though the experience that we had at the national park was unforgettably awesome, literally Buddi's given epic moment which was beyond our expectation. Enjoyed geographically treasured landscape and birds all the way around the river. Ending with majestic sunset went down the jungles with silence made me impressed. 200 percent worth to recommend.

title: Magical Stillness
text: We had a wonderful, peaceful morning, gliding across the glassy water, brushing through reeds, surrounded by stillness and the sounds of birds distant and near - sometimes with the addition of Buddhi's flute. I lost track of the different birds we saw - 40 or 50 by the end of the trip. Buddhi's enthusiasm, knowledge and keen eyes conjured them out of the sky and and around every rock. Not forgetting the water buffalos and water Monitor. A magical morning. Highly recommended.

title: Amazing Buddhi
text: Just to say how much we enjoyed our birdwatching tour with you - you are a very special person in a very special place You are a fine young man with star quality - you have a wonderful delightful and catching personality an excellent communicator with a gentle caring nature You are wellsuited to work in such a serene and peaceful setting with you respect for all aspects of nature and your environmental awareness We feel very fortunate to have you as our guide Your enthusiasm and passion is very catching Your knowledge of birds is unparalleled and your all seeing eyes and ability to identify birds close and from a far so quickly is quite amazing - in fact through you we were able to see 45 different species Remember knowledge is power - no one can take that away from you To be honest you are one of the most impressionable young men we have met in our two visits to Sri Lanka and I do not say that lightly You deserve huge success It was a pleasure to assist you with a pair of binoculars - you learnt the hard way but now you will gain even more knowledge as you will be able to identify the more finer details and characteristics of the birds This must be one of the most beautiful birds sancturies in the world for many reasons We can only strongly recommend you contact Buddhi on mobile +94 71 355 79 25 for a unique experience of a lifetime See you next year

title: Great Bird Watching with guide Buddhi
text: The wetlands are beautiful in the early morning, it was a very serene atmosphere. Buddhi our guide, has a lot of knowledge about the birds an was very enthusiastic.
